415b50f3.title: Solutions Engineer - I
415b50f3.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We build syncOS — the industry\-first no\-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
   

  

 As Botsync scales AMR demos across India and Southeast Asia, this Solution Engineer role owns everything between the demo fleet in Bengaluru and a live, working robot on a customer's floor — commissioning, running, and troubleshooting demos that convert prospects into customers.
   

  

**The roles and responsibilities:**
**Running demos on customer sites**
* Travel to customer plants and warehouses across India and Southeast Asia to set up and run live AMR demonstrations, typically 1 to 3 demos a month
* Unpack, commission and map a MAG\-series AMR on an unfamiliar floor within a single shift: network setup, mapping, waypoint and route configuration in syncOS, charging and docking checks
* Run the demo itself in front of plant managers, operations heads and safety teams, narrating what the robot is doing and answering questions on payload, navigation, safety and charging
* Diagnose and recover live on site when a floor behaves differently from the plan: reflective surfaces, poor WiFi coverage, uneven docking, changing traffic around the route
* Work to site rules at all times: PPE, permit\-to\-work, and safe operation around forklifts, pedestrians and live production


**Demo fleet readiness and logistics**
* Own the readiness of the demo fleet: batteries, chargers, magnetic tape, tote and trolley attachments, spares kit, and syncOS software versions matched to the demo scope
* Test every configuration end to end at the Bengaluru facility before it ships, so no robot leaves with a known open issue
* Coordinate packing, freight, customs paperwork and site access with operations for each demo, including cross\-border shipments into Southeast Asia
* Maintain the demo asset log and calibration records, and flag units that need refurbishment before they fail in front of a customer


**Feeding the sales and product loop**
* Work with the sales team before each visit to understand the customer's material flow and agree what the demo must prove: cycle time, payload, route, or integration with existing lines
* Write a short demo report within two working days covering what was shown, what the customer asked for, and what blocked or nearly blocked the run
* Log every product issue seen on site into the engineering tracker with logs, photos and reproduction steps, so recurring failures reach the product team with evidence
* Support the pre\-sales team with layout inputs, video and photo capture from demos, and the occasional trade show or partner event


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 1\-3 years of relevant experience in robotics, industrial automation, system integration, field applications, commissioning, or a related technical field
* Hands\-on experience commissioning or deploying mobile robots, AMRs, or similar automation hardware — network setup, mapping, and route/waypoint configuration
* Comfortable troubleshooting live, in unpredictable field conditions (connectivity issues, sensor interference, site\-specific quirks) without escalating every issue
* Strong presentation and communication skills — able to explain technical systems clearly to non\-technical audiences (plant managers, operations heads, safety teams)
* Willingness to travel extensively and work across multiple sites and countries on a recurring basis
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with sales, product, and operations teams, and writing clear, structured technical reports


**Highly desirable**
* Experience with fleet management, asset logistics, or spares/calibration tracking
* Familiarity with syncOS or comparable robot fleet orchestration software
* Prior experience in a pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or field applications engineering role


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

3b7d60a6.title: Solutions Architect
3b7d60a6.description:
**Company Description** 
 Digiprima Technologies is a next\-generation AI software development company that turns advanced technologies into practical business results. The team builds scalable, intelligent web and mobile applications for enterprises across the USA, UK, Europe, South Africa, the Middle East, and Australia. With over 10 years of experience, more than 2,000 successful projects, and clients in 40\+ countries, the company focuses on transforming operations, enhancing customer experiences, and driving measurable growth. Digiprima is a Microsoft Azure certified partner and ISO 9001:2015 certified, offering services spanning AI development, generative AI, NLP, predictive analytics, computer vision, enterprise software, IoT, and data analytics. The company supports diverse industries including FinTech, healthcare, smart manufacturing, retail, EdTech, real estate, automotive, supply chain, and more.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Solutions Architect role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Indore. In this role, the individual will design end\-to\-end technical solutions that align with client business goals, particularly for AI\-driven and data\-centric applications. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements, defining architecture blueprints, overseeing integration of systems and services, and guiding development teams on best practices and implementation details. The Solutions Architect will conduct technical assessments, provide consulting support on technology choices, ensure scalability, security, and performance of solutions, and participate in code and design reviews. The role also involves preparing technical documentation, supporting pre\-sales activities with architecture proposals, and working closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of projects.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Solution Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and maintainable systems.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Business Process skills to translate business needs into practical technical solutions and improvement roadmaps.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills with experience in modern programming languages, frameworks, and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Candidates should possess Integration skills, including APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and third\-party system integration.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience designing solutions in AI, analytics, or enterprise software environments is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with architectural frameworks and tools (e.g., UML, design patterns, infrastructure\-as\-code) and knowledge of security and compliance best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams and mentor developers.

d32b6fbc.description:

* Accounting Hub

* Accounts Receivable
* Cash Management

* Fixed Assets

Related capabilities may include Intercompany Accounting, Subledger Accounting, Financial Reporting, Enterprise Structures, security, approval workflows, integrations, and period\-close processes.


**What we are looking for** **:**

Argano is seeking a Principal Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Consultant to join our Managed Services practice. This client\-facing role provides ongoing functional support and advisory services across the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials suite. The consultant will own incidents, service requests, minor enhancements, quarterly update readiness, functional configuration, testing, and process optimization while working within agreed service levels and client priorities. The ideal candidate combines deep Oracle Fusion Financials expertise with strong knowledge of finance business processes and a proactive commitment to client success, system stability, and continuous improvement.


**Who we are** **:**

The Argano Managed Services division is unlike other managed services groups. We specialize in helping our clients transform their processes and enhance the end\-user experience. Creativity, teamwork, and loyalty are core principles that guide our daily actions. We have a unique corporate culture unlike any other firm in our business\-one that promotes healthy balance, respect, focus, friendship, and ongoing education. There are few firms in this industry that have a near zero employee turnover rate. We do. And it is something from which our clients benefit, and our employees celebrate. If you want to be part of an elite team where excellence is a way of life, join Argano.


**Responsibilities** **:**

* Using in\-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud Financial Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consult with clients to provide cost\-effective solutions to solve business issues.
* Provide high\-quality client support by triaging and owning incidents and service requests through resolution, gathering complete business and system information, communicating status and risks, and meeting agreed service\-level targets.
* Troubleshoot client issues through functional analysis, configuration review, data validation, log and process review, replication, root\-cause analysis, and regression testing. When vendor assistance is required, open and manage Oracle Service Requests, provide actionable evidence, and drive issues to resolution.
* Manage Oracle service requests through resolution, including diagnostics, follow\-ups, validation, and status updates.
* Lead Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update readiness activities, including reviewing new and deprecated features, assessing client impact, recommending opt\-in functionality, coordinating configuration changes, preparing test scenarios, supporting regression and user acceptance testing, documenting outcomes, and delivering end\-user enablement.
* Proactively contribute to the overall support process by suggesting \& executing new process efficiencies, documenting common support issues and workarounds, to minimize the number of future support requests.
* Refine client requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval.
* Identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving system issues.
* Participate in team training activities to keep current with Oracle Cloud functionality.

**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:****EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD (technical accounting, management system, Business Admin, etc.) expected.

**Required Skills** **:**

* Minimum 8–10 years of Oracle Financials functional consulting experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation or production support experience. Experience supporting multiple clients or complex environments in a managed services model is strongly preferred.
* Preferred to be a CPA/CA equivalent with an in\-depth understanding of finance business processes.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze Oracle Fusion Financials configurations, accounting rules, workflows, security roles, scheduled processes, reports, data loads, and integration touchpoints sufficiently to diagnose issues and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to independently research, reproduce, test, configure, and resolve client issues within agreed priorities and service levels while documenting root cause, resolution steps, testing evidence, and client communication.
* Ability to open, track, and manage Oracle Service Requests, including selecting appropriate severity, providing reproducible evidence, coordinating client actions, escalating when necessary, and validating Oracle\-provided solutions before closure.
* Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements and solving day\-to\-day issues.
* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Prior experience leading or managing projects.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external clients.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

  
Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.  

  

Argano is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

22dd623c.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
22dd623c.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.


Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

7c31df5d.title: Delivery Lead - Ai
7c31df5d.description:
**About the Role**
We are looking for a Delivery Lead \- AI who can help build and scale our AI organization.
This is not a traditional project or delivery management role. We are looking for a builder, owner, and AI leader who has experience taking something from an early stage and turning it into a successful product, service, team, or business function.
The ideal candidate could come from an AI/product company, a technology services organization where they built a new AI practice or service line, or an AI startup/venture they helped build from the ground up. **What You'll Own*** Scale the AI team,, processes, capabilities, and delivery.
* Lead high\-performing AI teams, with the ability to build toward 200\+ professionals.
* Own AI initiatives from idea and strategy through execution and scale.
* Work across Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Machine Learning, automation, and AI\-enabled products/services.
* Partner with leadership to define AI priorities, roadmap, operating model, and new business opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to turn AI capabilities into scalable products, services, and solutions.
* Build processes and structures that enable the organization to scale without compromising quality or speed.
* Develop people, create accountability, and build future AI leaders.
* Act as the bridge between AI, product, business, people, and delivery.

 **What We're Looking For*** 4–6 years of strong experience in AI, product, technology, consulting, or technology services.
* Proven experience building something from scratch, such as an AI product, practice, service line, startup, or new business function.
* Experience leading teams and taking ownership beyond formal responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of modern AI technologies and their practical business applications.
* Strong product and business mindset, with the ability to connect technology to real business outcomes.
* Entrepreneurial, hands\-on, highly accountable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
* Strong communication, decision\-making, and stakeholder management skills.

 **Who Will Stand Out?**
Someone who has built, not just managed.
This could be someone who:* Built and scaled an AI practice within a services company.
* Launched an AI product or new AI service line.
* Built an AI team and operating model from the ground up.
* Founded or co\-founded an AI\-focused startup or venture.
* Took an early\-stage AI initiative and turned it into a functioning team, product, or business.

 **What This Role Is Not:*** This role is not intended for a traditional delivery/project manager whose experience is primarily limited to managing timelines, resources, and existing processes.
* We are looking for someone who can create the playbook, build the team, solve problems along the way, and scale what they build.

 **What Success Looks Like:*** Success in this role means building an AI organization that is technically strong, commercially relevant, reliable in delivery, scalable in structure, and capable of continuously developing new AI products and services.
* If you've built something from zero and are ready to build something significantly bigger, we'd like to hear from you.

2d300ff7.title: SAP Delivery Manager
2d300ff7.description:
We are looking for experienced SAP Project/Program Manager.
 



  





 Job Description:
 



  





 1\. Project management: Planning, organizing, and managing all aspects of SAP projects, including scope, timelines, resources, and budget. This involves creating project plans, assigning tasks to team members, monitoring progress, and ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget.
 



 2\. AMS: Tracking and monitoring of tickets till closure. Carry out root cause analysis. Adherence to SLA compliance. Report back to all the stakeholders.
 



 3\. Team management: Leading and managing a team of SAP consultants and developers. This includes recruiting and training new team members, setting performance targets, providing coaching and feedback, and ensuring that the team has the necessary skills and resources to deliver projects successfully.
 



 4\. Client relationship management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, understanding their requirements and expectations, and ensuring that projects meet their needs. This involves regular communication with clients, managing their expectations, and addressing any issues or concerns they may have.
 



 5\. Quality assurance: Ensuring that SAP projects meet high\-quality standards. This includes conducting regular quality checks, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring that best practices and standards are followed throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 6\. Risk management: Identifying and managing project risks and issues. This includes proactively identifying potential risks, developing risk mitigation strategies, and taking necessary actions to resolve issues and maintain project progress.
 



 7\. Continuous improvement: Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices to enhance efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction. This involves staying up to date with the latest SAP trends and technologies and recommending innovative solutions to clients.

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, specifically designing, constructing, or managing projects.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience in software focused program/project management and in the business technology market.
* Knowledge of distributed software applications and the ability to quickly grasp new technical concepts.
* Ability to establish credibility and rapport with technical and non\-technical team members alike.
* Proven successful technical program management outcomes from idea to launching programs, throughout your career.
* Customer\-focused, intent on helping the team build an execution process that delivers incremental value on a frequent basis.
* Comfortable building relationships across functions, product areas, and organizational boundaries.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
   

  

 Job Introduction
   

  

 The Manager, Technical Program Management oversees the execution of complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives that support Tekion’s product and engineering strategies. This role manages program planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery execution across multiple technical teams. The ideal candidate combines deep technical understanding with strong program leadership and communication skills, enabling scalable execution in a fast\-paced environment.

* Drive planning and execution of high\-impact technical programs from concept through delivery across engineering, product, and cross\-functional stakeholders

* Establish operating rhythms for tracking progress, communicating status, and escalating issues across stakeholders

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on stakeholder alignment and delivery clarity

b42580b2.title: Solutions Engineer II
b42580b2.description:
**About Hologram**
 Hologram is building the future of IoT connectivity, delivering internet access to millions of connected devices worldwide. We process over 5 billion transactions per month across our global infrastructure, this isn't just another app, it's the invisible backbone powering everything from fleet tracking to smart city infrastructure. We tackle challenges of scale, reliability, and performance that few companies face.
   

  

**What Makes a Hologrammer?**
 We look for people with insatiable curiosity and an uncompromising commitment to excellence. Hologrammers are the type who dig deeper when things break, ask 'why' before 'how,' and aren't satisfied until the solution is bulletproof.
   

  

**You'll Love Working Here If You**
**Value tenacious ownership of outcomes:** 
 You don't just resolve tickets, you immerse yourself in the customer's use case, identify root causes, and follow through until their IoT devices are online and stable in production.
   

  

**Crave genuine technical challenges:** 
 You want the problems that keep production IoT deployments online: diagnosing connectivity issues across networks, devices, and protocols, then building the tooling so nobody has to diagnose that one by hand again.
   

  

**Relentlessly pursue growth:** 
 IoT technology evolves rapidly, and so do we. You take on new challenges, quickly master emerging protocols and configurations, and share what you learn to elevate customers and teammates.
   

  

**Solutions Engineer II**
**About This Role**
 The Solutions Engineering team owns the customer relationship after the sale, from first deployment through every connectivity issue that follows. This role covers onboarding, troubleshooting across SIM, device, and network issues, hands\-on L2 escalation work, and building the automation and internal tooling the team runs on. It's the first technical relationship a new customer has with Hologram, and the one that keeps their deployment live.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own customer onboarding end to end, from SIM provisioning and device configuration through to a deployment that is live and stable in production
* Diagnose and resolve SIM, device, and network\-level connectivity issues across the full deployment lifecycle, including L2 escalations, partnering with engineering on anything systemic
* Lead the team's automation work: find the manual work worth removing, then build it away
* Improve and automate the technical onboarding process, from SIM order intake through provisioning and connectivity setup, as new customers come through it
* Automate account\-health monitoring and alerting for Account Management team
* Maintain and expand internal tooling, including AI\-driven support tooling, along with the internal and external documentation behind it
* Advocate for customers internally, surfacing product gaps and technical pain points to product and engineering
* Write the runbooks and hand the work off, so any Solutions Engineer can pick up a build ticket and finish it
* Extend automation across the rest of the post\-sale path: SIM order intake, billing configuration and reconciliation, and renewal admin, partnering with Revenue Operations and the account team


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, or Technical Consultant), including ownership of customer onboarding through to production
* Solid understanding of cellular networks, IoT devices, various Radio Access Technologies (RATs), and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT)
* Experience working with scripting languages (e.g., Python or Ruby), SQL, and REST APIs
* A track record of building automations or integrations against real operational workflows, not just using them
* Experience applying AI tooling to real support, onboarding, or operational workflows
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non\-technical audiences
* Proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and technical concepts
* Comfortable working independently across a wide range of technical problems, and defining your own approach on work that has no established process yet
* Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and how record hygiene affects downstream reporting (nice\-to\-have)


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You…**
* Enjoy solving complex, technical problems that directly impact customer success
* Have a curious, self\-driven mindset and aren't afraid to dig into logs, APIs, or device configurations
* Thrive in customer conversations and can translate technical detail into clear, actionable guidance
* Are comfortable working across teams, from support and sales to product and engineering
* Enjoy taking a manual process and turning it into something clean, automated, and built to last


*Target Salary Range* 
*:* 
 $135,000 \- $150,000 \+ New Hire Equity grant (RSUs)
   

  

**How We Work At Hologram**
 Hologram is a fun, upbeat, and remote\-first team united by our mission to build a more connected future. We trust you to do what’s best for our product, customers, and team members and empower you to make the right calls without heavy bureaucracy.
   

  

**Benefits And Perks**
**Competitive compensation:** 
 All employees receive equity with transparent salary and equity formulas across the team
   

  

**Health \& time off:** 
 Flexible health coverage (up to 100% employee, 95% dependents), unlimited PTO with 2 weeks mandatory, monthly mental health days, and 14 weeks paid parental leave
   

  

**Remote work support:** 
 $1,000 hiring bonus plus $250/month taxable Work\-From\-Home stipend
   

  

**Financial security:** 
 Life and disability insurance fully covered, 401(k) plan, and Professional Development Fund after one year
   

  

 We pride ourselves on celebrating everyone; Hologram is an equal opportunity employer actively working on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment where underrepresented groups can thrive.
   

  

**What To Expect In The Interview Process**
* Intro call (15 min)
* Take\-Home Technical Assessment (45\-60 min)
* Peer Technical Interview (50 min)
* Cross\-Team Interview (30 min)
* Hiring Manager Interview (50 min)
* Leadership Interview (30 min)


**Ready to apply?**
 If you share our values and our passion for connecting the world, we’d love to review your application! For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email people@hologram.io.
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, please still consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

7383dfa5.title: Principal IT Solution Consultant - Planon
7383dfa5.description:
Your IT Future, Delivered.
   

  

 Principal IT Solution Consultant \- Planon
   

  

 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our offices have earned \#GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
   

  

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
 At IT Services, we are passionate about Planon’s Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS). Our Product Management team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of Planon Expert proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.
   

  

*\#DHL \#DHLITServices \#GreatPlace* 
*\#Planon*
**Grow together.**
 Timely delivery of DHL packages around the globe in a way that ensures customer data are secure is in the core of what we do. You will provide second/third level day\-to\-day operation support, and help investigate and resolve incidents, which were not resolved in lower support levels. Sometimes, issues might get tricky and this is where cooperation on troubleshooting with other IT support teams and specialists will come into play. When it comes to firmware bugs, vulnerabilities and other issues related to our technologies, communicating with our vendors is key.
   

  

 For any issues related to telecommunication/security systems within the DHL Group environment, you are our superhero. The same applies when it comes to managing, proposing and implementing all necessary changes to production security devices in all IT Services Data Centers and premises, providing global availability to key DHL Group services.
   

  

 Last but not least, security technologies associated with Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs, Proxies, Azure and Google Cloud are all in your support league.
   

  

**Grow together – Suggestion as part of Global Planon Specific**
 As part of the Global Planon Team, you will play a key role in keeping our worldwide Planon environment running smoothly while driving continuous improvements across the platform.
   

  

  

* Consult and deliver changes in our global Planon syste, partnering with business and IT stakeholders to design, implement, and document stable, scalable, and high\-quality solutions.
* Ensure reliable day\-to\-day operations by supporting and troubleshooting the Planon platform, resolving incidents, and maintaining system stability for our global user community.
* Enable and guide key users by providing functional support, sharing best practices, and helping them fully understand and leverage the capabilities of the Planon system.
* Implement and monitor interfaces to other systems
* Collaborate in an international environment, working closely with colleagues, business partners, and service providers to continuously improve processes and user experience across DHL's Corporate Real Estate ecosystem.


**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**
 As a Planon Expert, having strong FM/real‑estate domain knowledge, and solid technical skills (SQL, Java/JavaScript, APIs), with Planon’s own implementation/functional certifications strongly preferred is a huge plus.
   

  

**About The Role**
* As our global Planon environment grows in scale and complexity, we are strengthening our internal development capabilities. We are therefore looking for both experienced Planon Experts and motivated professionals ready to grow into an expert role.
* You will consult on and implement changes within our worldwide Planon system, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to deliver stable, scalable, and well\-documented solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as lead consultant for complex Planon implementations and changes. especially with the Facility Management area of Planon
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable end\-to\-end Planon solutions.
* Design and implement advanced Planon configurations, business rules, JavaScript and Java (TMS) extensions.
* Define technical solution designs and guide less experienced colleagues.
* Implement complex Planon Gadgets, PSS Forms, TSIs, including JavaScript and SQL add\-ons.
* Design and validate testing approaches, ensure system quality, stability, and compliance with standards.
* Ensure high\-quality documentation, code reviews, and solution transparency.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Understanding of Facility Management area of Planon
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Planon configuration and customization.
* Deep understanding of Planon business rules, workflows, and FM processes.
* Strong experience with Java, JavaScript, and SQL in a Planon context.
* Proven experience with Planon Web Frontend and mobile configurations.
* Ability to work independently in a global, cross\-functional environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

ab4f4316.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
ab4f4316.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.  



  

The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.  



  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.
**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.
**Skills:**
-----------

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.
All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.


We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

9972d37c.title: EOP Global Solution Architect
9972d37c.description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**
 You will be a key technical leader within the Mondelēz International Digital \& Technology organization, responsible for designing, securing, and integrating the o9 Enterprise Operations Planning (EOP) platform across our global supply chain. You will drive architectural excellence and ensure seamless integration between o9, SAP, and non\-SAP applications to enable world\-class planning capabilities across NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 You will serve as the Solution Architect for the o9 EOP platform, owning the end\-to\-end technical architecture, security framework, and integration landscape. You will work closely with business stakeholders, platform vendors, and internal technology teams to ensure that the o9 platform delivers scalable, secure, and high\-performing planning solutions. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Design and govern the overall o9 EOP solution architecture, ensuring alignment with Mondelēz enterprise architecture standards and global technology strategy.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of integrations between o9 and SAP (S/4HANA, ECC), as well as non\-SAP applications including Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Define and enforce security architecture standards for the o9 platform, including data governance, access controls, role\-based security, and compliance with MDLZ information security policies.
* Evaluate and recommend o9 hosting environment options (self\-hosted vs. o9\-managed cloud) for NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions, assessing trade\-offs in performance, cost, security, and scalability.
* Collaborate with the o9 product team and internal DevOps teams to optimize platform performance, minimize application downtime, and improve batch/FTB job scheduling strategies.
* Provide technical leadership during solution design reviews, architecture governance, and key project milestones including Go\-Live readiness.
* Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, integration specifications, and technical documentation to support ongoing operations and future wave rollouts.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams — including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, and IT — to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks across the integration landscape and drive resolution of complex platform issues.
* Stay current with o9 platform innovations, including Agentic AI capabilities, and assess applicability to MDLZ planning processes.


**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
   

  

* Solution architecture design for enterprise planning platforms, preferably o9 Solutions, SAP IBP, or equivalent supply chain planning tools.
* Deep expertise in SAP integration architecture — including SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA — and non\-SAP application integration such as TPM and SAC.
* Designing and implementing API\-based, event\-driven, and middleware integrations (e.g., MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, or similar).
* Security architecture principles including identity and access management (IAM), data encryption, network security, and cloud security frameworks.
* Cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience evaluating hosting models for enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Supply chain planning domains including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S\&OP, and financial integration.
* Communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Working in large\-scale, global, matrixed organizations with multiple regional teams and vendors.
* Agile and DevSecOps ways of working within enterprise program delivery.


**More About This Role**
 What you need to know about this position:
   

  

* This role supports the o9 Wave 1 – Demand program and subsequent wave rollouts across NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions.
* The Solution Architect will be accountable for the technical integrity of the o9 EOP platform, including all integration touchpoints with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Close collaboration with the o9 vendor team, SAP CoE, and MDLZ enterprise architecture teams is essential.
* The role sits within the Digital \& Technology function and reports into the o9 Program Leadership.


 What extra ingredients you will bring:
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with o9 Solutions platform configuration, data models, and APIs is a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics capabilities within enterprise planning platforms.
* Experience with Trade Promotion Management (TPM) systems and their integration into planning workflows.
* Familiarity with MDLZ or FMCG/CPG supply chain processes is highly desirable.


**Education / Certifications:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical engineering discipline. Engineering background strongly preferred.
* Professional certifications in Solution Architecture (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly desirable.
* SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP Integration Suite) are a plus.
* o9 platform certifications or formal training, where available, are an advantage.


**Job specific requirements:**
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in IT/technology roles, with at least 5 years in a solution architecture capacity.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise platform implementations with complex integration landscapes.
