1cffd65b.title: Solutions Architect - Business Systems Engineering
1cffd65b.description:
Searce's process\-first transformation practitioner \& AI solutions builder — futurifying enterprise operations from the ground up.
 



  





**We identify better ways of doing things.** 




**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.** 




 We're searching for the architects of the audacious \& the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re\-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.
 


* Improver. Solver. Futurist.
* Great sense of humor.
* ‘Possible. It is.’ Mindset.
* Compassionate collaborator. Bold experimenter. Tireless iterator.
* Natural creativity that doesn’t just challenge the norm, but solves to design what’s better.
* Thinks in systems. Solves at scale.



**This Isn’t for Everyone.** 
 But if you’re the kind who questions
 *why* 
 things are done a certain way—and then identifies 3 better ways to do it — we’d love to chat with you.
 



  





**Your Mission: The Role** 




 solving for better.
 



 As a Senior Architect in Business Systems Engineering, you aren’t here to ‘implement AI.’ You are here to
 **futurify** 
 how businesses actually work — from the inside out. You will
 **hands\-on diagnose, redesign, and deploy AI\-powered process solutions** 
 , working alongside clients to deliver transformation that actually sticks.
 



 This is a chance to
 **stop “experimenting”** 
 and
 **start “solving.”** 
 You sit at the convergence of
 **AI Solution Building** 
 and
 **Business Process Re\-engineering.** 
 Your mission: deconstruct chaotic domain processes (in Supply Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, 3PLs, Warehousing, Transportation and Manufacturing) and reconstruct them as intelligent, autonomous, production\-hardened workflows.
 



**This Seat is for You If...** 



* You are a
 **"Process\-First" Builder:** 
 You believe an AI model is worthless if it doesn’t fundamentally improve the underlying business metric. You diagnose the process, then you build the fix.
* You are
 **Hands\-On by Nature:** 
 You don’t just design solutions — you build them. You can go from process map to working prototype in the same week.
* You
 **bridge Workshops and Working Code:** 
 You can run a process discovery session with a client’s ops team in the morning and review an API integration with engineers in the afternoon.
* You
 **Value Impact Over Hype:** 
 Solving a logistics bottleneck, a customs dispute, or a billing reconciliation failure matters more to you than any experimental POC.
* You are a
 **Real Improver:** 
 You don’t settle for done. Iteration is your personality. Under\-promise, over\-deliver — always.



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 what you will wake up to solve.
 



**1\. Business Transformation Consulting** 



* Turn client operational chaos into clear, prioritized modernization roadmaps — as a trusted AI advisor to business and IT stakeholders.
* Run workshops and process mapping sessions that move decisions. Drive adoption, not just deployment.



**2\. AI\-Powered Process Architecture \& Build** 



* Diagnose and re\-engineer complex processes using first\-principles — then design AND build the AI solution around it.
* Integrate AI into enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, TMS, BPM) in production\-hardened architectures, not decks.



**3\. The 'Agentic' Shift** 



* Build Agentic AI systems where agents plan, reason, and execute inside real enterprise processes — procurement, reconciliation, triage, scheduling.



**4\. Delivery \& Client Advocacy** 



* Own your workstreams end\-to\-end — scope, timelines, quality, client communication. Accountable, not just contributing.
* Bridge business and tech fluently, close the feedback loop, and enable client adoption post\-deployment.



**5\. Collaborative Building \& Growth** 



* Be the dot\-connector in modernization squads — alongside architects, analysts, and engineers.
* Grow fast, own early, mentor when you can. Ship things. Build a reputation for it.



  





**Functional Skills** 




**1\. Delivery Excellence \& Client Impact** 



* **Process \& AI Solutioning:** 
 Operates at the intersection of business process re\-engineering and AI solution design — diagnosing problems first, then building the intelligence around them.
* **Client Engagement:** 
 Builds trusted working relationships with client stakeholders. Translates their operational pain into actionable technology solutions.
* **Delivery Ownership:** 
 Owns workstream delivery — scope, quality, timelines, and client communication. Not just contributing, but accountable.
* **Structured Problem\-Solving:** 
 Breaks chaotic, cross\-domain challenges into solvable chunks using first\-principles thinking — then builds the AI solution around it.
* **Feedback Loop Mastery:** 
 Gathers, synthesizes, and acts on end\-user feedback to iteratively improve deployed solutions.



**2\. Technical Execution Charter** 



* **Hands\-On AI Building:** 
 Designs and builds production\-grade AI solutions: LLM integrations, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation — with working code, not just diagrams.
* **Cloud\-Native Fluency:** 
 Functional knowledge of modern AI system design (RAG Frameworks, Agentic Workflows, Inference Optimization) across GCP and AWS.
* **BPM \& Enterprise Systems:** 
 Working knowledge of BPM methodologies (BPMN, value stream analysis, workflow automation) and enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, TMS, Pega, Appian, ServiceNow).
* **Integration \& Configuration:** 
 Integrates, configures, and tests multiple enterprise systems — ensuring seamless interoperability and real\-world performance.
* **Quality \& Governance:** 
 Adheres to technical quality standards: model validation, testing coverage, and ethical AI governance — non\-negotiable in production.



  





**Tech Superpowers** 



* **Hands\-On AI Solution Building:** 
 Strong practical expertise in building AI solutions: LLM integrations, Agentic AI frameworks, RAG pipelines, and workflow automation. You ship things, not just design them.
* **Process\-to\-Architecture Translation:** 
 Translates messy business process requirements into clean, deployable AI system designs — always grounded in what will actually work in production.
* **Cloud\-Native AI Fluency:** 
 Proficient in GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML) and/or AWS AI/ML ecosystems. You build and deploy AI solutions in the cloud, not just consume cloud services.
* **Software \& Engineering Foundation:** 
 Solid software engineering background — you've built real systems. Can review code, debug integrations, and validate technical decisions at the solution level.
* **BPM Tooling \& Low\-Code Fluency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with BPM platforms and Low\-Code/No\-Code tools (Power Platform or similar) for rapid process automation alongside AI integrations.



  





**Experience \& Relevance** 



* **A hands\-on AI solution builder \& process transformation practitioner with 5–12 years of experience** 
 — spanning technology delivery, AI solution design, and business process re\-engineering.
* **Leadership Track Record:** 
 Proven track record of delivering end\-to\-end AI and process modernization solutions — from discovery workshops to production deployment. Not just advisory; you’ve built things that run in production.
* **Applied AI Experience:** 
 Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI\-powered workflows, agentic systems, intelligent automation, or LLM integrations in real client environments.
* **BPM \& Domain Knowledge:** 
 Working knowledge of process re\-engineering methodologies and at least one process\-heavy industry: Supply Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, 3PLs, Warehousing, Transportation, or Manufacturing.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** 
 Experience working directly with business stakeholders — running workshops, presenting solutions, and owning delivery outcomes in client\-facing roles.



  





**Bonus Points (you will thrive if you have)** 



* **Founder’s Energy:** 
 Bias for action, thrive in ambiguity, relentless focus on outcomes. You’ve built something from zero.
* **Low\-Code/No\-Code Fluency:** 
 Experience with AI integrations via Power Platform or similar for rapid process automation.
* **AI Copilots \& Agentic Builders:** 
 Built plugins, copilots, or agentic automation frameworks — in production, not just POCs.
* **Thought Leadership DNA:** 
 Industry content creation, technical blogs, conference talks, or public contributions to AI/BPM discourse.
* **Ethical Compass:** 
 Strong commitment to responsible AI — governance, fairness, and transparency built into design from day one.
* **Engineer at Heart:** 
 Background in product development or engineering before moving into consulting. That builder credibility shows.
* **Domain Depth:** 
 Vertical expertise in Supply Chain, Logistics, BFSI, Healthcare, or Manufacturing — process\-heavy industries where transformation actually matters.



  





**Join the ‘real solvers’** 




 ready to futurify?
 



 If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI\-native engineering\-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses,
 **apply here** 
 and experience the ‘Art of the possible’.
 **Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.**

87a50f79.title: Solution Architect
87a50f79.description:
The Solution Architect is responsible for the design, integrity and quality of the SAP solution and of associated IS services delivered to Business, Support Functions and IS Technology domains as the case may be. Responsible that the SAP solution/service provides the required functionality and meets the requirement of business. Collaborates with and contributes to project set\-up and delivery as well as to service operations optimization.
   

  

 The Solution Architect is accountable for managing workstream interdependencies mainly but not restricted to the specific End\-to\-End Stream.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Defines the technical SAP solution/ E\- Invoicing and ensures alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration across solution architects.
* Supports validation and prioritization of incoming business demand in collaboration with Project owners, business function and unit as well with the relevant IS Business Analyst, IS Service Manager, IS Application Manager and/or Global IS Domain Architect.
* Be responsible for translating the functional design into functional and technical specifications, review and sign off the functional and technical use case specifications.
* Communicate the technical specifications to the developers. Joining unit testing and support on UAT testing and defect resolution. Managing the transport request and it's status update until release to Production system.
* Formulate rules, principles and guidelines to guide the development of the technical solutions. Determine non\-functional requirements and ensure service/ solution operation standards are considered accordingly. Keeps knowledge up to date regarding new and emerging IS technology and IS industry practices, bringing learning into HE; all within in the scope of the relevant IS solutions.
* Collaborates with users in projects and problem management to maintain, develop and deploy the best feasible and most\- cost efficient IS solutions/services for the business. Ensures solution documentation and training material are well maintained and created.
* Consults, gives advice and supports the installation of new E \- Invoicing solutions/services, or the changing of existing solutions/services. Consults the users to identify and learn about current procedures and to clarify further requirements.
* Supports the installation, management, maintenance, and optimization of all E\- Invoicing processes related to the area of responsibility. Provides guidance to IS project management and IS delivery unit team in how to utilize IS application/solution standards (e.g. SAP) effectively.
* Commits and contributes to common result oriented collaboration with the various business processes IS architectural domains as well as the various enterprise technology IS architecture domains. For assigned tasks, executes all actions in IS processes according to agreed RACIS specification.
* In concert with the Global IS Domain Architect ensures that IS solution/service\-related standards are considered accordingly. Provides support to temporary work teams, guiding and monitoring task completion, sharing expert knowledge and advice with/without carrying line responsibility.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer science (preferred) or related discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience within Information Technology industry with solution architecture experience across various IT areas with focus in the areas of S/4 HANA system with E \- Invoicing
* Practical implementation experience with integration software/tools: BizTalk and/or MuleSoft.
* International work experience in different countries/ cultures.
* Proven experience implementing SAP best practices, especially for smooth transition for carving out a business division from current SAP landscape to a different one.
* Highly adept at bridging, translating and integrating business with IT, and converting business requirements into IT solutions. Ability to provide leadership to ensure effective solutions that drive business value are created and implemented, in an environment of virtual teams.
* Awareness of latest technology, developments and offerings from SAP and their future direction. Able to sort through complex issues and make timely decisions. Ability to generate new ideas, challenge status quo, take risks, support change and foster innovation.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes
* Proficiency in both spoken \& written English language is required.

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud\-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.


* Client \& Stakeholder Management
+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands\-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption


* Cloud, Automation \& Deployment Engineering Leadership
+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue\-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.


* MLOps, Data Pipelines \& Operationalization Leadership
+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real\-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud\-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service\-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise\-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk\-sensitive environments.


* Asset and Accelerator Development
+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.


* Business Development \& GTM Initiatives
+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry\-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.


* Program Governance \& Delivery Excellence
+ Oversee end\-to\-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross\-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.


* Practice Development \& Team Leadership
* 
+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
**Education:**
* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).


**Core Technical Expertise (Hands\-on Implementation Required):**
* AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands\-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API\-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation \& Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering \& Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming \& APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security \& Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.


**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications


**Consulting \& Leadership Experience:**
* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi\-cloud architecture programs.


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.


**Portfolio Requirements:**
 Hands\-on experience in building production\-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

6c9b70a1.title: Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Platforms
6c9b70a1.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Infrastructure Specialist for Cloud Platforms, you will manage and implement infrastructure solutions across various cloud environments according to established designs, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate cloud infrastructure solutions based on existing designs.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Set Up and Configure Cloud Infrastructure: Set up, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases across different cloud platforms to effectively support business applications.
* Implement and Oversee Cloud Resources: Implement and oversee essential cloud resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Load Balancers, and Cloud Storage solutions to ensure smooth operations.
* Monitor and Troubleshoot Infrastructure: Continuously monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance.
* Apply Security Measures: Apply and enforce security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Optimize cloud costs by right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Cloud Services Proficiency: Exposure to cloud services from providers such as Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others, with expertise in Linux and VMware environments.
* Automation Tools Experience: Exposure to automation tools like Terraform, Ansible, and native cloud automation services to automate and streamline processes.
* Cloud Migration Project Experience: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, with a focus on effective planning and delivery.
* Kubernetes Cluster Management: Proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters across various cloud environments for effective container orchestration and scaling.
* DevOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), with an understanding of their application in cloud infrastructure management.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Cloud Cost Optimization Techniques: Exposure to methods for optimizing cloud costs, including right\-sizing resources, developing cost\-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns to minimize expenses.
* Advanced Cloud Security Measures: Experience with implementing and enforcing advanced security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure compliance with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Multi\-Cloud Environment Expertise: Exposure to managing and implementing infrastructure solutions across multiple cloud environments, including Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others.

11599442.title: Principal Consultant - Client Services (Oracle Cloud Financials)
11599442.description:
**Job Description**
**Oracle Cloud Financial Modules:**
* Accounting Hub

* Accounts Receivable
* Cash Management
* Expense Management
* Fixed Assets
* General Ledger

 Argano is seeking a Principal Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Consultant to join our Managed Services practice. This client\-facing role provides ongoing functional support and advisory services across the Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials suite. The consultant will own incidents, service requests, minor enhancements, quarterly update readiness, functional configuration, testing, and process optimization while working within agreed service levels and client priorities. The ideal candidate combines deep Oracle Fusion Financials expertise with strong knowledge of finance business processes and a proactive commitment to client success, system stability, and continuous improvement.

 The Argano Managed Services division is unlike other managed services groups. We specialize in helping our clients transform their processes and enhance the end\-user experience. Creativity, teamwork, and loyalty are core principles that guide our daily actions. We have a unique corporate culture unlike any other firm in our business\-\-one that promotes healthy balance, respect, focus, friendship, and ongoing education. There are few firms in this industry that have a near zero employee turnover rate. We do. And it is something from which our clients benefit, and our employees celebrate. If you want to be part of an elite team where excellence is a way of life, join Argano.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Using in\-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud Financial Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consult with clients to provide cost\-effective solutions to solve business issues.
* Provide high\-quality client support by triaging and owning incidents and service requests through resolution, gathering complete business and system information, communicating status and risks, and meeting agreed service\-level targets.

When vendor assistance is required, open and manage Oracle Service Requests, provide actionable evidence, and drive issues to resolution.

* Lead Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update readiness activities, including reviewing new and deprecated features, assessing client impact, recommending opt\-in functionality, coordinating configuration changes, preparing test scenarios, supporting regression and user acceptance testing, documenting outcomes, and delivering end\-user enablement.
* Proactively contribute to the overall support process by suggesting \& executing new process efficiencies, documenting common support issues and workarounds, to minimize the number of future support requests.
* Refine client requirements in detail, document and present to the client for approval.
* Identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving system issues.
* Participate in team training activities to keep current with Oracle Cloud functionality.


**MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD (technical accounting, management system, Business Admin, etc.) expected.


**Required Skills**
* Minimum 8–10 years of Oracle Financials functional consulting experience, including at least 3 years of hands\-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation or production support experience. Experience supporting multiple clients or complex environments in a managed services model is strongly preferred.
* Preferred to be a CPA/CA equivalent with an in\-depth understanding of finance business processes.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze Oracle Fusion Financials configurations, accounting rules, workflows, security roles, scheduled processes, reports, data loads, and integration touchpoints sufficiently to diagnose issues and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to independently research, reproduce, test, configure, and resolve client issues within agreed priorities and service levels while documenting root cause, resolution steps, testing evidence, and client communication.
* Ability to open, track, and manage Oracle Service Requests, including selecting appropriate severity, providing reproducible evidence, coordinating client actions, escalating when necessary, and validating Oracle\-provided solutions before closure.

* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external clients.

**About Us**
 Argano is the first of its kind: a digital consultancy totally immersed in high\-performance operations. We steward enterprises through ever\-evolving markets, empowering them with transformative strategies and technologies to exceed customer expectations, unlock commercial innovation, and drive optimal efficiency and growth.

 Argano is seeking a EPM Planning Consultant for our Client Services practice. 054b2d63.title: PS Consultant (Genesys Cloud)
054b2d63.description:

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The position is integral to the on\-going technical solution deployment and technical application support of professional services (PS) capabilities. This includes five key areas:
   

  

* Demonstrates product expertise in most Genesys Cloud products
* Provides top quality service engagements for large or strategic customers or other accounts serving as the lead technical advisor and/or engineer
* Follows PS implementation standards
* Assesses complex Genesys Cloud implementations to make appropriate recommendations to both Genesys and the customer
* Initiates and suggests process improvements to Project Managers / Service Delivery Managers and other Management to increase efficiencies for delivery of Genesys Cloud solutions or support


**Major Responsibilities/Activities**
 The Genesys Cloud consultant is responsible for delivering and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions for customers or Partners. This position is responsible for developing a high level of expertise across the majority of Genesys products. The consultant should be flexible to work on post\-production support projects as well.
   

  

**Technical Consultation**
* Works closely with Project Managers / Service Delivery Managers in successfully delivering implementation and support projects.
* Delivers technical implementation activities post\-sales for PS engagements as required for key customers and to load balance with the rest of the team
* Follows PS implementation standards
* Delivers post\-GoLive production support activities and customer environment management (Operational Support Management/OSM)
* Execution of project plan tasks associated with engagements
* Test plan validation in close collaboration with Quality Assurance team
* Regular communication of project status
* Provides onsite/remote support for customer escalations as needed
* Maintains on average of 70\+% utilization for billable projects
* Identifies engagement\-related problem areas and solves the issues in a proactive manner
* Assists the Customer Care organization in performing service call/maintenance activities as required
* Provide technical training to internal or external resources as needed
* Maintains friendly and professional attitude in stressful situations
* Collaborate and consult directly with customers as an individual contributor in our Professional Services team.
* Be prepared to operate on one or more projects at a time due to skill demand.
* Flexible to support post\-production (Operations Service Management) type projects
* Own the troubleshooting of production solutions where necessary.
* Operate within both Agile and Waterfall engineering methods.
* Meet expectations of the Professional Services processes such as within\-budget and quality deliverables, time and status reporting, mentoring, best practices, documentation, debriefs and training certification up\-keep.


**Administration**
* Maintains accurate and timely submission of timesheets, expense reports, and project\-related forms
* Maintains regular internal communications with project team, team lead, and manager.
* Provides feedback and updates to internal process through internal documentation
* Follows standard department processes.


**Training**
* Continues to stay abreast of new Genesys product releases through internal training, shadowing experienced consultants, lab development, and industry standards training/certifications


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Technology/Telecommunication or related discipline or equivalent professional technical experience
* 3\+ years of related experience
* Prior experience with Genesys Cloud Implementation and/or Administration is mandatory
* Prior experience working on Genesys Digital Channel customer projects deploying Email, SMS, ChatBot, Social media channels will be a plus.
* Good technical problem\-solving skills and ability to collaborate in troubleshooting challenging configurations.
* Flexibility to work across different time zones specifically North America
* Flexibility to take up a operational service management role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need


**Technical Skills**
* Knowledge of HTTP requests, REST web services, and JSON
* IP Telephony \& Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper\-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)
* Software Development experience in Java and C\#.NET, Python, PHP, web application development scripting, tools and methods is a BIG Plus
* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7
* Knowledge on Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a bonus


**Business Skills**
* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.
* Prior experience in working in a customer facing role
* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.
* Exercises good judgment
* Strong follow\-through, ownership \& responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps


 Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

 Get notified about relevant opportunities.

 Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. **Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. 7f8e1ee9.title: Technical Delivery Lead
7f8e1ee9.description:
**Entity**
 Technology
   

  

**Job Family Group**
 IT\&S Group
   

  

**Job Description**
**Technical Delivery Lead – Corporate Affairs Digital Platforms**
**Role Profile / Job Description**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the technical delivery of digital platform changes, product enhancements and operational improvements across Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services. The role acts as the bridge between delivery, product, architecture, engineering, operations and business stakeholders, ensuring technical solutions are clearly defined, prioritised, delivered, tested and transitioned into support effectively.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on technical delivery leadership with selected Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, requirements definition, sprint planning support, acceptance criteria, prioritisation and value realisation. This ensures delivery teams focus on the right outcomes and that solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, supportable and aligned to business needs.
   

  

 Scope \& Scale
   

  

**Area**
**Scope**
**Platform focus**
 Supports one or more Corporate Affairs digital platforms, products or services, such as Brand Portal, global web, campaign, content, analytics or operational support capabilities.
   

  

**Technical delivery**
 Leads technical delivery across releases, enhancements, integrations, operational improvements and service transition activities.
   

  

**Product ownership**
 Owns or supports backlog management, story refinement, prioritisation, acceptance criteria and value\-based delivery decisions.
   

  

**Team coordination**
 Coordinates engineering, architecture, QA, security, privacy, operations, supplier and business teams to deliver agreed outcomes.
   

  

**Operational readiness**
 Ensures solutions are production\-ready, supportable and aligned to non\-functional requirements, governance and operating model expectations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Lead technical delivery of platform changes, product enhancements, integrations and operational improvements.
* Coordinate developers, architects, QA, infrastructure, security, privacy, analytics, support teams and suppliers.
* Ensure technical work are clearly defined, sequenced, estimated, delivered, tested and released.
* Identify and manage technical dependencies, risks, blockers, assumptions and decisions.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, service transition and post\-launch stabilisation.
* Ensure solutions align to architecture, security, privacy, accessibility and operational standards.


 Product Ownership \& Backlog Management
   

  

* Define, refine and maintain the technical backlog in partnership with Product Managers, Delivery Managers and business partners.
* Translate business outcomes into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritise backlog items based on business value, technical risk, compliance needs, dependencies and delivery capacity.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, demos and delivery reviews.
* Review and accept completed technical work against agreed acceptance criteria.
* Ensure delivered features provide measurable value and align to platform standards and user needs.


 Requirements, Analysis \& Solution Definition
   

  

* Work with business, product and technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and desired outcomes.
* Break down complex technical and business needs into structured, testable delivery items.
* Surface assumptions, constraints, risks and dependencies before development begins.
* Support discovery, solution options, impact assessments and technical feasibility reviews.
* Maintain clear user documentation, decision logs and delivery artefacts.


 Platform Readiness \& Operational Support
   

  

* Ensure platforms and services are technically ready for production use and BAU support.

 Agentic AI for Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management 
 



  





 Delivery Manager \- RCM AI 
 



 Where Deep RCM Expertise Meets Agentic Transformation 
 



 Location: Chennai or Coimbatore    
 



 Experience: 12\+ years    
 



 Function: Delivery \& Client Transformation 
 



  





 About the Role 
 



 You understand revenue cycle the way few people do. You have lived the daily reality of eligibility checks 
 



 that stall, prior authorizations that pile up, claims that deny for reasons that should not exist, and accounts 
 



 receivable that ages while teams scramble. You have led the people who fight those battles — and you 
 



 have likely wondered why so much of this work still depends on humans performing the same repetitive 
 



 tasks again and again. 
 



 At Droidal.ai, we asked the same question, and we built the answer: AI agents that take on revenue cycle 
 



 workflows end to end and actually perform the work. We are now looking for someone who has been in 
 



 the trenches of healthcare RCM to lead how we deliver that transformation to our provider clients. 
 



 This is a Delivery Manager role \- but it is best understood as the bridge between hard\-won RCM domain 
 



 expertise and the future of how revenue cycle work gets done. You will be the person providers trust to 
 



 understand their operations deeply and to deliver agentic transformation that measurably improves their 
 



 financial outcomes. 
 



 Why This Role Is Different 
 



 Most delivery roles manage tickets and timelines. This one calls for something rarer: a leader who can sit 
 



 across from a provider’s Vice President of Revenue Cycle, speak their language fluently, diagnose where 
 



 workflows break, and then orchestrate AI agents and delivery teams to fix them. 
 



 If you are a subject\-matter expert or operations leader at a large RCM billing company \- or you run revenue 
 



 cycle operations for a health system \- the proposition is straightforward. You have mastered a domain that 
 



 is about to be transformed, and you can either watch that transformation unfold or lead it. Here, your deep 
 



 knowledge of denials, coding, AR, and payer behavior becomes the engine that makes AI deliver real 
 



 results. 
 



 Key Responsibilities 
 



 • Client Facing \- Serve as the trusted delivery partner for provider clients, understanding their revenue 
 



 cycle operations deeply and keeping client satisfaction consistently high while ensuring measurable 
 



 financial impact. 
 



 • Delivery Management and Lead agentic transformation. Take ownership of how Droidal’s AI agents 
 



 are deployed across client RCM workflows \- translating operational challenges into automation that 
 



 delivers results. 
 



 • Provide RCM expertise. Bring subject\-matter authority across the end\-to\-end revenue cycle: front
 



 end (eligibility, prior authorization, registration), mid\-cycle (coding, charge capture, clinical 
 



 documentation integrity), and back\-end (claims, denials, AR follow\-up, payment posting). 
 



 • Manage and grow people. Build, mentor, and motivate delivery teams, leading with clarity and care 
 



 to make transformation real for clients. 
 



 • Partner across the business. Work with product and engineering to channel client needs into how 
 



 our agents evolve, and with client partners to ensure delivery consistently exceeds expectations. 
 



 • Apply a consulting mindset. Diagnose before prescribing, and frame every engagement in the metrics 
 



 providers care about \- clean claim rate, denial rate, days in AR, and cost to collect. 
 



 What You Bring 
 



 • 10\+ years in healthcare revenue cycle management, with deep, hands\-on expertise across the end\-to
 



 end cycle. 
 



 • Proven experience as a Delivery Manager, RCM operations lead, or subject\-matter expert at an RCM 
 



 billing company, BPO, or healthcare provider. 
 



 • Strong command of front\-end, mid\-cycle, and back\-end RCM workflows, payer dynamics, and the 
 



 metrics that define success \- clean claim rate, denial rate, days in AR, and cost to collect. 
 



 • Demonstrated people\-management experience building, leading, and mentoring operational delivery 
 



 teams. 
 



 • A consulting mindset: you diagnose root causes, design solutions, and communicate in outcomes. 
 



 • The ability to engage credibly with provider executives, including VP of Revenue Cycle, CFO, and 
 



 operations leadership. 
 



 • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client\-relationship skills. 
 



 • Familiarity with, or strong curiosity about, AI, automation, and their impact on healthcare operations. 
 



 • A bachelor’s degree is required; relevant RCM certifications such as CRCR, RHIA, or CPC are a strong 
 



 advantage. 
 



 • Willingness to be based in Chennai or Coimbatore, with client interaction as required. 
 



 What Makes You Stand Out 
 



 You have owned the metrics that keep a revenue cycle leader up at night, and you have moved them in the 
 



 right direction. You have sat with a frustrated provider client and left them confident. You think in root 
 



 causes rather than symptoms. And somewhere in you there is a builder who would rather shape the future 
 



 of revenue cycle than continue managing its present. 
 



 Why Droidal.ai 
 



 We sit at the frontier of agentic AI for healthcare \- deploying agents that providers are using to transform 
 



 revenue cycle operations and see real, measurable results today. You will join early enough to influence 
 



 how we deliver, with the autonomy to run your clients and teams as if they were your own business. This is 
 



 not a delivery seat to fill; it is an opportunity to help redefine how revenue cycle work gets done. 
 



 Ready to turn your RCM expertise into the future of healthcare operations? 
 



 Apply now or reach out directly. We would be glad to meet the person who has been waiting for exactly 
 



 this role. 
 



 Droidal.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

**Job Description**
**Job description \-** 
**Manager – Cloud (Risk Consulting – Digital Risk)**
**Requisition ID \- TBC**
 EY focuses on high\-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY GDS, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY GDS become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
   

  

 Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud\-related security and technology risks.
* Lead and execute cloud security and risk assessments, including control design and operating effectiveness testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Collaborate with engagement teams to plan engagements, develop work programs, timelines, risk assessments, and testing procedures.
* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high\-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands\-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud\-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high\-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non\-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber\-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end\-to\-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation\-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice\-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.


**To qualify for the role, you must have.**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client\-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud\-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large\-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

a0232e4e.title: Presales Specialist
a0232e4e.description:
**Company Description** 




  





 SRCHN is building the discovery and engagement layer for Bengaluru’s offline economy.
 



 Bengaluru is filled with cafés, restaurants, breweries, hotels, workspaces, retail destinations, and lifestyle experiences, yet discovering what is actually worth experiencing remains fragmented across maps, social media, search, and word of mouth.
 



 SRCHN brings these experiences together through an interactive Hyper\-Local Map.
 



 Built using Google Maps data, map types, and layers, our map combines location intelligence with video\-first discovery. Instead of simply showing where a business is, SRCHN helps people understand what the place feels like, what it offers, and why they should experience it.
 



 We curate brands and experiences onto the SRCHN Hyper\-Local Map and create a complete content layer around every participating location.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Presales Specialist role at SRCHN is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Bengaluru. This role involves partnering with the sales team to understand client needs, preparing tailored product demonstrations, and supporting the development of proposals and presentations. The Presales Specialist will analyze customer requirements, translate them into solution recommendations, and participate in discovery calls, meetings, and workshops. Daily responsibilities include responding to presales queries, coordinating with product and delivery teams, and ensuring that prospects clearly understand the value and capabilities of SRCHN’s offerings. The role also includes gathering feedback from potential clients to refine messaging, support product enhancements, and contribute to improved sales processes.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess client requirements, interpret data, and develop relevant solution recommendations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage with prospects, explain complex concepts clearly, and build trust throughout the sales cycle.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Presales skills to conduct discovery sessions, design solution approaches, and support the preparation of proposals and demos.
* Candidates should have proficiency in presentation tools (such as PowerPoint or similar), and the ability to create clear documentation and sales collateral.
* Candidates should demonstrate the ability to collaborate with sales, product, and technical teams, managing multiple opportunities in a structured and organized manner.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, IT, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in presales, solution consulting, or a customer\-facing technical role is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Retail or E\-Commerce solutions, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment will be beneficial.

62d80929.title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect
62d80929.description:
**Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect \- Presales**
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C\-level executives, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization \& Innovation:
+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:
+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing \& Risk Management:
+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:
+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA\-7/ESP/Control\-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large\-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re\-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client\-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.


 IBM Mainframe administration certification

7d303f89.title: PLA Principal, Enterprise Solutions
7d303f89.description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 ERP: Finance Focus (FICO)
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Finance Specialist, you will lead finance transformation programs leveraging ERP solutions such as SAP S/4HANA FICO, Treasury, and Financial Planning \& Budgeting. You will collaborate with client CFOs, finance leaders, and BCG partners to deliver end\-to\-end ERP\-enabled finance modernization initiatives.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead finance\-focused ERP transformations across General Ledger, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, and Treasury Management.
* Drive integration between Controlling (CO), Project Systems (PS), and Planning \& Budgeting.
* Provide strategic guidance on finance data models, cost allocations, and statutory reporting.
* Design future\-state processes for financial close, consolidation, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (IFRS, GAAP) and internal controls.
* Work closely with clients to optimize Capex/Opex through ERP and digital finance initiatives.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years in ERP finance roles with deep SAP FICO, Treasury, or BPC/Group Reporting experience.
* Experience designing and deploying end\-to\-end finance solutions in S/4HANA or equivalent ERP.
* Exposure to projects integrating finance with supply chain, procurement, and HR.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and project accounting.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Transformation leaders.


 ERP – Sales and Distribution Focus (SD)
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Sales Specialist, you will lead end\-to\-end design and delivery of ERP sales, order management, and pricing processes using SAP SD, AATP, and CRM/BRIM capabilities.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead ERP transformations across Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Billing, and Pricing processes.
* Implement and optimize SAP SD, AATP, and integrated CRM/BRIM platforms.
* Enable digital customer experience and omnichannel sales models within ERP.
* Develop revenue recognition and subscription\-based pricing capabilities.
* Collaborate with marketing and supply chain functions for integrated sales operations.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years’ experience in ERP\-led sales and customer operations transformation.
* Deep SAP SD and CRM/BRIM expertise; AATP experience preferred.
* Strong grasp of order fulfillment, returns, rebate, and pricing management processes.
* Exposure to industries like CPG, manufacturing, or telecom.
* Experience engaging with Sales, Commercial, and Digital Transformation leaders.


 ERP – Procurement and Supply Chain Focus
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Procurement \& Supply Chain Specialist, you will design and implement ERP\-driven procurement and sourcing processes that deliver efficiency, transparency, and savings. You will lead initiatives using SAP MM, WM, and complementary tools like Ariba, Coupa, and iValua.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead ERP transformations in Procurement, Vendor Management, and Warehouse Operations.
* Architect and integrate eProcurement and Source\-to\-Pay platforms (Ariba, Coupa, iValua) with ERP.
* Optimize inventory and warehouse operations through SAP MM and WM modules.
* Enhance supplier collaboration through catalogs, SRM, and spend analytics.
* Develop KPIs for procurement effectiveness, compliance, and sustainability goals.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years’ experience in ERP procurement and logistics, with deep SAP MM and WM expertise.
* Working knowledge of QM, SRM, Ariba, Coupa, or iValua integration with ERP.
* Strong understanding of supply base rationalization, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
* Experience advising CPOs and Procurement Transformation teams.
* Exposure to AI/analytics\-driven procurement insights preferred.


**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions.
