17b121a3.title: Senior Partner Platform Architect
17b121a3.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

### **About Us:**

Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS\-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.  



  

### **Position Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co\-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands\-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.  



  

### **Core Daily Activities**

* Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.
* Co\-Sell Technical Support: Collaborate closely with partners during co\-sell engagements, providing expert technical guidance and solving complex implementation challenges.
* Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
* Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.
* Drive Innovation and Emerging Technology Adoption: Stay updated on AI, ML, and automation trends in contact centers to continuously improve partner technical capabilities.
* Support Pre\-Sales and Post\-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.  
* 

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner\-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
* Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
* Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co\-sell strategies.
* Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.  
* 

  

### **Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner\-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
* Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
* Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
* Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner\-centric contexts.  
* 

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with omnichannel contact center solutions, AI\-driven automation, workforce engagement management, and reporting tools.
* Agile Experience: Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

 The Opportunity
   

  

**Avantor Fluid Handling (AFH)** 
 offers customized Single\-Use Solutions that cater to the unique needs of biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturers throughout the process workflow. Our solutions include single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and associated hardware designed to support critical manufacturing operations.
   

  

 The role of an Applications / Technical Sales Manager is pivotal in creating impactful solutions for our customers. With deep process knowledge, technical expertise, and commercial acumen, the individual will lead a team of Application Specialists and deliver innovative solutions that address the unique application needs of clients across biopharmaceutical, vaccine, biological, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biopharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of industry experience in Biopharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Vaccines, Biologicals, and/or Sterile Pharmaceutical Manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge across bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing workflows, including upstream processing, downstream processing, formulation, buffer/media preparation, sterile manufacturing, and fill\-finish operations.
* Experience working with external customers within the Biotech, Biologicals, Life Sciences, Vaccine, and/or Injectable Pharmaceutical industries.
* Experience supporting customers supplying products to highly regulated markets such as the United States, Europe, Japan, and other ICH\-regulated regions.
* Strong understanding of customer manufacturing processes, technical challenges, material requirements, and evolving industry expectations.


 Regulatory \& Compliance Knowledge
   

  

* Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to single\-use technologies used in biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of Extractables \& Leachables (E\&L), supplier qualification programs, GMP/cGMP expectations, change control, quality risk management, sterility assurance, contamination control, validation requirements, and regulatory expectations from US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other global agencies.
* Awareness of BPOG Single\-Use guidance and USP / ISO standards relevant to single\-use systems, fluid contact materials, sterilization, biocompatibility, and particulate control.


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Purpose\-driven, with passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges that advance life\-changing science.
* Customer\-focused, solution\-oriented, and able to convert technical insight into meaningful business impact.
* Strong leadership, communication, influencing, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


 Who You Are
   

  

* A Subject Matter Expert (SME) who partners closely with commercial teams, product managers, quality teams, and R\&D scientists to achieve business objectives.
* Possess deep understanding of bioprocessing workflows and/or sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
* Strong understanding of customer technical challenges, process requirements, material requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Capable of engaging effectively with stakeholders across Process Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement.
* Demonstrated project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical engagements and strategic opportunities.
* Able to develop and maintain strong technical relationships with targeted key accounts.
* Passionate about driving innovation and continuously improving AFH products, solutions, and service offerings.
* Possess strong knowledge of regulatory expectations associated with single\-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and critical process components used in regulated manufacturing environments.


 How You Will Thrive and Create an Impact
   

  

* Play a key role in identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing project opportunities, ensuring effective support for both internal and external customers.
* Contribute to the technical positioning of AFH products within customer manufacturing processes and influence strategic decision\-making.
* Improve the quality, competitiveness, and value proposition of AFH products and service offerings.
* Gather, compile, and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to identify unmet needs and create differentiated solutions.
* Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging market trends to guide future product and service development.
* Stay current with industry, technology, and regulatory developments and communicate insights across the organization.
* Support local and global sales processes, strategic account management initiatives, and business growth objectives.
* Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers within strategic customer accounts.
* Provide technical and regulatory guidance regarding implementation, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of single\-use systems.
* Support customer discussions related to supplier qualification, extractables and leachables assessments, contamination control strategies, particulate risk management, sterilization validation, and change management processes.
* Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, Operations, and R\&D teams to ensure AFH solutions align with current and evolving regulations and standards.
* Participate in customer audits, technical reviews, product evaluations, and qualification activities as required.
* Support both biopharmaceutical and sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing customers in achieving compliance, operational excellence, and process optimization.


**Preferred Industry Experience**
 Candidates with experience supporting leading biopharmaceutical, vaccine, CDMO, biologics, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturers supplying regulated markets such as US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH\-regulated regions will be highly preferred.
   

  

 Biopharma / Biotech Applications

 Plasma products

 Sterile injectables

 Complex generic injectables
   

  

 US \& EU regulated\-market supply
   

  

 Success Profile
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate combines deep bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing expertise, strong understanding of single\-use technologies, knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements for regulated markets, proven technical sales and key account management experience, leadership capability to build high\-performing technical teams, and the ability to translate customer needs into commercially successful solutions.

 The Genesys Cloud consultant is responsible for delivering and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions for customers or Partners. **Job Description for Senior Big Data Architect at Niveus:**  

Niveus is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Big Data Architect to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable big data solutions that meet our clients' business needs. You will work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders to create robust data architectures that support advanced analytics and data\-driven decision\-making.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

Design and develop large\-scale, end\-to\-end data platform architectures: covering ingestion, storage, processing, and analytics/consumption layers.
  
  

Architect and implement Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, and Data Lake solutions following Medallion architecture best practices.
  
  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable, secure data solutions.
  
  

Evaluate and implement appropriate big data and cloud\-native technologies and tools.
  
  

Design and manage the consumption layer, including data access management, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and data marketplace enablement.
  
  

Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and security across the entire data lifecycle.
  
  

Optimize existing data architectures and workflows for performance and cost\-efficiency.
  
  

Proactive in client conversations, technical demos, presentations, and solutioning discussions, representing the technical/architecture point of view.
  
  

Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in big data, cloud, and analytics.
  
  

Skills and Tools Required
  
  

Strong architectural understanding of the complete data platform: Data Warehouse, Data Lakehouse, and Data Lake (Medallion architecture) \- BigQuery /Trino / Redshift / Databricks
  
  

Extensive experience with big data technologies such as, Spark, and Kafka.
  
  

Proficiency in programming languages such as Python.
  
  

Proven experience designing scalable, secure data pipelines, data warehouses, and data lakes capable of processing petabytes of data.
  
  

Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, Medallion architecture, and data warehousing concepts.
  
  

Mandatory hands\-on experience with at least one cloud platform \- GCP strongly preferred (AWS or Azure also considered).
  
  

**Architectural experience designing data platforms end\-to\-end:** ingestion, storage, and analytics/consumption layers.
  
  

Working knowledge of the consumption layer \- data access management, RBAC, and data marketplace concepts.
  
  

Familiarity with database technologies including NoSQL, SQL, and data lakes.
  
  

Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
  
  

Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
  
  

**Value add:** Experience in client\-facing technical conversations, demos, presentations, and solutioning.
  
  

Relevant certifications in big data or cloud technologies are a plus.
  
  

If you are a proactive, innovative thinker with a passion for big data solutions, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our exciting journey at Niveus.

d8c1ff57.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
d8c1ff57.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

1b335075.title: Sr. Salesforce Developer - Sales Cloud
1b335075.description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Sr. Salesforce Developer \- Sales Cloud to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN\-DL), India (IN).
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Sales Cloud Developer to design, develop, and deliver scalable CRM solutions on the Salesforce platform. The role involves deep technical expertise in Sales Cloud, strong hands\-on development capabilities, and the ability to work across cross\-functional teams to drive business outcomes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities

2\. Sales Cloud Expertise

* Territory Management
* Sales Process Automation

* REST/SOAP APIs
* Middleware tools (e.g., MuleSoft preferred)

* Implement role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, and permission sets.
* Ensure compliance with security and governance standards.

* Support release planning, version control, and rollback strategies.


6\. Performance Optimization
  
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.

* Work closely with business analysts, architects, admins, and stakeholders.

* Proficiency in Salesforce APIs and integrations.

Experience

* Experience working in enterprise\-scale environments.


Certifications (Preferred/Expected)

Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
  
* High\-quality, scalable Salesforce solutions.

57c65310.title: MIST - Delivery Manager
57c65310.description:
**About M\&G India**

  

We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

  

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

  

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.

 **About M\&G**

  

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

  

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.

  

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

 **Delivery Manager – Model Development**


Working within the **Model Implementation \& Support** team, part of the **Actuarial Modelling \& Valuations** function in **M\&G Finance**, this role is responsible for coordinating the delivery of model development activity across a complex portfolio of change. The role requires **strong delivery management experience**, with the ability to turn agreed scope into clear plans, coordinate stakeholders across teams, and maintain momentum through effective tracking, issue management and communication.

**What you’ll do**


Scope \& prioritisation

* Collate and shape model development scope, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives, and that changes to agreed scope are assessed and agreed through a change control process
* Coordinate input to assess effort, dependencies and delivery options
* Support agreement of funding and resource allocation with relevant budget holders


Delivery planning \& execution

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans with named owners, milestones, dependencies and progress tracking
* Drive disciplined execution through effective resource planning, RAID management and regular check\-ins with delivery owners
* Ensure delivery activity remains aligned across workstreams and that emerging issues are surfaced early


Progress \& risk management

* Provide regular progress updates, including clear issue flagging, escalation routes and recommended actions
* Track costs against agreed funding and highlight any emerging risks or pressures
* Maintain RAID logs, supporting timely resolution


Governance \& stakeholder communication

* Prepare materials for key meetings and governance forums, track actions and ensure appropriate follow\-up
* Support engagement with internal review teams and external audit where required
* Provide clear communication to stakeholders on progress, risks, dependencies and actions needed to keep delivery on track


Cross\-initiative coordination

* Coordinate delivery across related model development initiatives to support joined\-up implementation and effective handover into valuation and reporting processes

  

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

6e8fdc24.title: Technical Delivery Manager
6e8fdc24.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Delivery Manager to join us on an exciting journey as we modernize our core platforms to make them Simpler, Leaner and more Efficient. You will utilize your strong industry and domain expertise to shape up our Technology product offerings to meet the Business requirements for the future. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience in managing large multi\-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well\-developed collaborative mindset.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Cloud Technologies (public or private).
* Understanding of any Liquidity Management or Core Banking Product suite.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 The role combines project leadership, technical understanding, commercial ownership, and strategic problem\-solving.

 You’ll operate in a globally distributed, virtual\-first environment with significant autonomy and flexible working practices.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to shape a growing India\-based delivery function while creating measurable outcomes for global customers.

* Own end\-to\-end delivery for a portfolio of 8–12 concurrent implementation projects, managing plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, budgets, and go\-live readiness.

* Support cross\-functional initiatives involving platform rollouts, data migrations, upgrades, and other strategic implementation programs.

* Commercial awareness and experience with SOWs, services scoping, utilization, revenue tracking, or related commercial processes.
* Excellent customer\-facing communication skills, with the ability to lead meetings, produce clear reporting, influence stakeholders, and manage expectations across international time zones.

3dd6ccab.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
3dd6ccab.description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Overview**
**Job Description**
 Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) within Visa has a strategic growth initiative to expand beyond core consumer card payments (C2B) and into broader money movement flows between individuals, businesses, and governments. The investments that Visa has made over decades in C2B provide Visa with the infrastructure, technical capability, brand, expertise, and relationships to tap into money movement between a much broader coupling of counterparties (B2B, B2b, B2C, P2P, G2C, G2B, etc.). The target market opportunity of more than 185T in potential volume is a Board\-level aspiration for the company, with an aggressive net revenue CAGR forecast of 25%\+ over the next five years.
   

  

 Visa is evolving from legacy Agile to outcome\-led, telemetry\-driven, human\-accountable delivery to unlock faster innovation, greater customer impact, and higher productivity through a single agentic pipeline with Human in the loop.
   

  

 Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) is a key business within (CMS responsible for growing all flows between businesses and governments from SMBs to the largest global corporates. We enable business and government entities of all sizes to thrive in dynamic global and local markets, by providing innovative end\-to\-end payment capabilities and frictionless experiences that simplify the critical processes that businesses perform daily. These critical processes include managing expenses, compliance, vendors and reporting and of course, making payments. Our suite of products and solutions deliver better cash flow, productivity, administrative efficiency, reconciliation, control and acceptance for clients. Visa is the number one payment network for small businesses, and we are rapidly growing our depth and breadth of solutions for large corporates and governments. We work closely with Issuers, Merchants, FinTechs and other ecosystem players to deliver these services.
   

  

 The VCS PMO team has responsibility for driving transformation, enabling and orchestrating the end\-to\-end delivery on Fiscal year OKRs and organizational strategy. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations \& Infrastructure, Cyber\-Security, Client Services, and other key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.
   

  

 The VCS PMO team has responsibility for driving transformation, enabling and orchestrating the end\-to\-end delivery on Fiscal year OKRs and organizational strategy. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations \& Infrastructure, Cyber\-Security, Client Services, and other key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.
   

  

 Lead Technical Program Manager for Visa Commercial Solutions will provide oversight and governance on cross\-functional delivery of the VCS programs \& initiatives as well as ensure seamless and timely planning, prioritization and execution, leveraging the Visa Agentic Tool Chain (VATC). This role is critical for a successful delivery of the 2030 Strategic objectives and milestones on the product \& technology roadmap.
   

  

 The person must possess a can\-do attitude, a growth\-oriented mindset, process\-focused and an ability to deal with change and ambiguity. Candidates must have a high technical background, extremely data centric and analytical, and be willing to learn new technologies, leverage Claude Code, Gen AI and other Agentic AI technologies to optimize and govern the programs. (S)he must understand the products and solutions being developed and possess a keen business acumen. Experience in Enterprise Operational methodologies (Agentic, Agile, Stage gate) is highly preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deep expertise in steering and implementing large scale product development transformations from ground up and act as a point of contact with geographically disbursed teams where risk and ambiguity is high, and outcome driven.
* Manage the team’s growth, learnings, and overall development while aligning with the organization’s and PMO’s goals.
* Partner with Product \& Technology leads to drive and ensure effective Annual Operational Planning, Quarterly Product Reviews and program reviews leveraging Visa Enterprise tools (GitHub, ServiceNow, Clarity, Power BI, Jira/Jira Align).
* Help and facilitate prioritization of Initiatives \& Epics (Product requirements) that align to the Objectives \& Business Results (OKRs) and available workforce capacity.
* Manage resource rosters for their Portfolios or Team of Agentic Squads in Jira, Jira Align and Polaris
* Manage program forecasts, budgets, labor capitalization and asset depreciation/amortization.
* Ensure effective participation of the teams in the Quarterly Planning activities across programs, collaborating with partners in Operations \& Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other Visa Technology verticals.
* Ensure that the program and projects follow Visa's Agentic Lifecycle Methodology and Key Controls, and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status in various forums and reporting modes.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the PMO team and the scrum teams on adopting agile best practices. Be the leader in advancing the ongoing transformation to Visa’s Agentic Lifecycle Management Operating Model.
* Learn and adopt Visa’s Secure Software Development Lifecycle Management (SSDLC), Golden Rules, release management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes.
* Provide telemetry in quality, flow, and value metrics\-based reporting to all stakeholders, hold regular program\-level reviews
* Cultivate a mindset of rigorous planning \& prioritizing while proactively identifying risks and dependencies to accelerate value realization.
* Manage cross\-functional communications to maximize understanding, impact, and speed of change adoption.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the Engineering, PMO and Product teams on adopting agile best practices and a cadence of portfolio, program \& team level ceremonies.
* Capture metrics \& measurables that clearly indicate progress toward accomplishment of Reimagining Work at Visa Initiative.
* Develop a rigor for understanding and leveraging the productivity, quality, flow, usage, adoption , and value\-based metrics to accelerate benefit realization.
* Generate and improve the agility metrics (performance, predictability, and persistency) by optimizing and governing the Visa processes for planning, budgeting, prioritization, delivery, release management, workforce planning and stakeholder (ELT, SLT) reporting.
* Assist and support with External (FFIEC) \& Internal audits on the program. Ensure that all programs supported by the PMO adhere to always audit compliant processes.
* Ensure that identified security vulnerabilities are addressed and remediated in a timely manner to prevent non\-compliance. Ensure that exceptions are obtained in a timely manner and kept to a minimum.
* Volunteer for additional responsibilities related to Visa processes, cross\-functional project governance and hiring of team members and participate in required fire drills.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Essential Qualifications:
   

  

* 16\+ years of work experience in technical program management or software development with a Bachelor s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters/MBA/JD/MD) or at least 5 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience developing plugins \& agents using Claude Code, cline or other AI Agentic tools
* Enterprise Program Management Tools (Jira, Jira Align, (Clarity, Primavera, HP PPM etc.).
* Scaled Agile Certification (SAFe for Teams, Leading SAFe, Implementing SAFe, SAFe for Release Train Engineers).
* Experience with analytical reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI.)
* Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including GitHub, Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc
* Experience in managing large\-scale engineering and operational projects.
* Experience in driving alignment with business objectives across multiple teams.
* Experience in implementing advanced project management techniques.
* Experience in promoting innovation within technical program management.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Scaled Agile Framework Certified – SAFe Agilist or SAFe Program Consultant
* Program Management Professional (PgMP) and/or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Experience with JIRA Align, Tableau, Power BI.
* Experience with project management techniques software development lifecycle in a Fin\-Tech background scrum or agile experience.
* Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence/Machine learning to improve. effectiveness of the Product delivery.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

34346ee6.title: Technical Program Manager
34346ee6.description:
Job Description: Technical Program Manager (Hackathons \& Innovation Challenges)
 



 Position: Program Manager
 



 Location: Noida, UP, India (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**The role** 




 You are the single point of ownership for every program you run — end to end, from pre\-launch kickoff to the final debrief. Not the coordinator of it: the owner. Scope, the client relationship, and the final call all sit with you.
 



 What makes this role different from a conventional program management role is where the ownership comes from.
 



 You will be the trusted partner for our clients and the central hub for all internal teams, ensuring that every hackathon is delivered flawlessly, on time, and within budget. This role is for a natural leader who thrives on structure, excels at communication, and has a passion for turning ambitious ideas into reality.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Technical program design. Problem statements, evaluation criteria, judging rubrics, and tech\-stack fit. You decide what a good submission looks like and defend that standard to clients and juries.
* End\-to\-end program ownership. Multiple concurrent programs from post\-sales handover through delivery and debrief. Scope, objectives, timelines, and resourcing are yours to define.
* The client relationship, post\-sales. Primary point of contact once sales hands over. You set expectations, manage change, and are the voice on technical scope and feasibility — including on what isn’t deliverable.
* Strategic program architecture. You build the blueprint. Defining objectives, resource allocation, and timelines is your domain. You ensure every component is technically sound and logistically viable before a single line of code is written.
* Internal cross\-functional bridge. You lead the charge across Marketing, Operations, and SME teams. You are the glue that keeps diverse internal stakeholders aligned and focused on delivering a cohesive product.
* Risk and quality gatekeeping. Spotting friction before it happens. You own the mitigation strategies and maintain a relentless standard for the participant experience and final deliverables.
* Scope and fiscal discipline. You hold the line on the budget and the agreed\-upon roadmap. Using rigorous verification, you ensure we deliver exactly what was promised without slippage.
* External partner synchronization. Managing the ecosystem. You direct third\-party vendors and partners to ensure their contributions integrate seamlessly into the live event execution.
* Documentation and executive reporting. Maintaining the narrative of progress. You provide clear, direct visibility on milestones and technical hurdles to both clients and our leadership team.
* Jury and participant experience. Recruiting and briefing evaluators, running the judging process with rigour, and making sure the experience holds up for developers and students who chose to spend a weekend on it.



  





**What you'll need** 



* Deep technical fluency. You can hold an architecture\-level conversation with a client, a jury, or a partner without escalating it. You can read a submission and judge whether it actually works. Hands\-on coding is not required — credible technical judgement is non\-negotiable.
* Experience. 4–7 years in program or project management in a technical environment — technical program management, developer relations, solutions or pre\-sales engineering, or an engineer who moved into program work. Enterprise clients somewhere in that history.
* Domain expertise. Working knowledge of the domains we run challenges in — AI/ML, cloud, and data at minimum. Enough to tell an ambitious problem statement from an unworkable one.
* Enterprise client\-facing strength. Polished, direct, and comfortable holding a line on scope with a senior stakeholder who wants more than was agreed.
* Organisational discipline. Several programs running at once, each with its own client, timeline, and jury. Detail matters and slippage is visible.
* Developer and student community instinct. You understand what makes a hackathon worth entering, and what makes participants disengage.

5883acb9.title: Pre-Sales Consultant — Defence & Government
5883acb9.description:
**About Globals:**
 Globals has drastically grown from a small home office to a globally recognized enterprise offering world\-class quality solutions on Cybersecurity, Cyberwarfare, ERP Systems, AI, and Enterprise Application Development for various industries including Defence, Education, Government, Financial Services and Transport Industries. Globals has enabled its customers to be game\-changers in their industry through its disruptive and innovative solutions. Globals is certified as a "Great Place to Work" organization for its laudable work culture that helps its team members manage work\-life, have dedicated hours to upskill and reskill themselves, and most important to ensure that the projects that they are working on are always unique, challenging their status quo every time. Our unique work culture has made us one of the world’s fastest\-growing technology companies as recognized and featured by The Economist. Our excellence in technical stewardship and service\-offering expertise has facilitated our clients ranging from individual entrepreneurs to Fortune Global 500 – to explore new business opportunities, reduce their operational costs significantly and boost their revenues. Today, Globals enjoys a strong position in the industry as a high\-performing leader through its technology innovation and remarkable domain expertise. Globals is a CMMI Level 5 certified company.
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We're hiring a Pre\-Sales Consultant to be the technical bridge between our engineering teams and defence and government buyers — DRDO labs, MoD units, PSUs, and system integrators. You'll own technical positioning, proof\-of\-concept delivery, and RFP/tender responses across our satellite \& space cybersecurity, drone security, SDR/RF security, and PKI/quantum\-safe cryptography lines, translating deep technical capability into solutions that mission stakeholders can evaluate and buy.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with the business development team on defence and government accounts to understand mission requirements, threat models, and procurement processes.
* Translate technical capabilities — PKI and quantum\-resistant cryptography, CCSDS/satellite protocols, MAVLink and C2 link security, SDR/RF hardening, cryptographic module compliance under India's IT Act/CCA framework — into clear solution narratives for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical discovery calls, site visits, and stakeholder briefings with defence and government customers.
* Design and deliver proofs\-of\-concept and live technical demonstrations across satellite/space cyber, drone/UAV security, and SDR/RF capability areas.
* Own the technical sections of RFP, RFI, and tender responses, working with engineering and the technical writing team to produce compliant, credible submissions aligned to DRDO/MoD procurement formats.
* Build and maintain technical collateral — solution briefs, architecture diagrams, and capability decks — with correct handling of sensitive and controlled information.
* Track the competitive landscape and relevant compliance frameworks (MoD Cyber Security Policy, CERT\-In guidelines, ISRO/DRDO standards) that shape active bids.
* Support pricing and BOM discussions with technical trade\-off input, and coordinate with legal on NDA, export\-control, and classification requirements.


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of experience in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or technical account management, ideally within defence electronics, aerospace, satcom, or cybersecurity.
* Demonstrated prior experience working within the Indian defence industry — DRDO, MoD, Defence PSUs, or a defence\-focused System Integrator/OEM — is required.
* Working knowledge of at least two of: satellite/space systems (CCSDS, ground segment operations), drone/UAV platforms and C2 links (MAVLink, PX4/ArduPilot), SDR/RF security (GNU Radio, SDR hardware), or PKI/cryptography (X.509, IT Act/CCA crypto compliance, post\-quantum crypto).
* Familiarity with Indian defence procurement processes (DRDO, MoD Cyber Security Policy, GeM/tender workflows).
* Comfortable presenting technical material to both engineers and senior government/defence stakeholders.
* Strong technical proposal writing and documentation skills.
* Engineering degree (CS, ECE, Aerospace, or related field); willing to travel to defence and government establishments.

**Nice to have:**
* Direct experience on ISRO\-affiliated space programmes.
* Bilingual in Hindi and English for government stakeholder communication.
* Relevant certifications in RF engineering, cryptography, or embedded security.

**The Team** 




**Team:** 
 Solutions Strategists, part of Wingify's global PreSales organization
 



**Coverage:** 
 APAC \- East Asia, South East Asia, ANZ and India
 



**You'll work with:** 
 the VP Sales APAC, regional Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, and the Solutions Strategist covering Europe and MEA
 



**Role overview:** 
 You will be Wingify's first dedicated Solutions Strategist in APAC, building the strategic PreSales practice for the region from the ground up alongside existing regional Sales and Solutions Engineering teams.
 



**Who We Are** 




 Wingify is a global leader in experimentation, personalization and conversion rate optimization, born from the merger of AB Tasty and VWO. Together, we help some of the world's most ambitious brands turn insight into revenue across every digital touchpoint.
 



 With teams spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and Asia\-Pacific, we partner with enterprise customers across retail, travel, media and financial services to build and scale high\-performing CRO and CXO programs. As we grow our Enterprise footprint globally, we're expanding the PreSales organization that makes our biggest deals win.
 



**Your Mission** 




 As a Solutions Strategist, you own the strategic and business narrative on Wingify's most complex Enterprise and strategic deals. You partner with the Account Executive and the Solutions Engineer as one team. Your work is structured around four levers:
 



 •
 **Differentiate:** 
 build one coherent strategic narrative across the entire pre\-sales journey, frame competitive differentiation at every step, and strategize ahead of an upcoming opportunity on strategic and key deals.
 



 •
 **De\-Risk:** 
 address the perceived risks that stall Enterprise evaluations (switching cost, resourcing, governance readiness, and CRO/CXO maturity) through direct CXO\-level conversations
 



 •
 **Visualize:** 
 make Wingify's impact tangible for each specific deal (tailored market and vertical insight, tool/suite fit, use cases built from real analysis of the prospect's business, and competitive positioning.)
 



 •
 **Prove:** 
 turn a ROI model into a business case narrative the Champion can defend in front of Finance, translating gains, savings and break\-even into language a CFO expects.
 



 Beyond the four levers, you will:
 


* Contribute to the strategic response and differentiation on complex, competitive RFPs.
* Steer multi\-stakeholder POCs and complex evaluations, facilitating decisions across technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as an evangelist for Wingify at conferences, webinars and workshops.



**What You'll Bring** 




**Core Competencies** 



* **Organizational Diagnosis:** 
 Assess an organization's CRO/CXO maturity and political dynamics within a single conversation, asking the right questions to enrich the Sales team's account intelligence.
* **Business \& Technical Diagnosis:** 
 Spot optimization opportunities at a glance and reframe a functional brief into the 2\-3 underlying problems Wingify can solve.
* **Product \& Solution Mastery:** 
 Understand how our solutions work well enough to quickly assess use case feasibility, propose new ones, and recommend the most relevant products for a prospect's context.
* **Consultative Posture:** 
 Hold consultative conversations on the execution of a CRO/CXO strategy, including on challenges peripheral to the tools themselves such as governance, resourcing or process.
* **Narrative \& Competitive Positioning:** 
 Build a narrative that puts our tools' value into sharp relief and position effectively in an intensely competitive context.



**Mindset \& Behaviors** 



* Active listening and organizational acumen : reads stakeholder dynamics and unspoken politics, not just stated requirements.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving : synthesizes and prioritizes quickly under ambiguity.
* Intellectual curiosity and learning agility : genuine appetite to dig into how things work without waiting for all the answers.
* Consultative presence and executive credibility : comfortable challenging a prospect's thinking without arrogance.
* Communication and storytelling : clear and compelling at executive level, composed under competitive pressure.
* Multi\-threading and autonomy : manages multiple stakeholders, issues and deals in parallel, structuring the approach on each account independently.



  





 If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!
 



**Why You'll Love It Here** 



* Make a Real Impact: sit at the center of Wingify's biggest deals and directly influence win rate and deal size.
* Ownership \& Autonomy: no micromanagement, just the freedom to own your region's strategic deals.
* International Culture: collaborate with a diverse, global PreSales, Sales and Product organization spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and APAC.
* Career Development: vast opportunities for professional growth as Wingify scales its Enterprise footprint globally.



**Details** 




**Contract:** 
 Permanent, full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 India

5b23f31f.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
5b23f31f.description:
**Company Description**
 Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
   

  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

b7bf1a90.description:
**Company Description:** 
 NEXUS AIDC is a San Francisco\-based AI infrastructure company building the intelligent operating layer for next\-generation AI data centers. We are part of the NVIDIA Inception Program, Intel Partner Alliance, and AWS for Startups, positioning NEXUS within a global ecosystem advancing AI compute and data center infrastructure. Our platform brings together infrastructure observability, AI workload performance, DCIM, FinOps and intelligent operations to help enterprises and data center operators manage increasingly complex AI infrastructure at scale.
 



 We are looking for an ambitious, technically sharp Pre\-Sales Engineer (Solutions Engineer / Sales Engineer) with 2 to 3 years of experience to support our growing enterprise sales efforts across the Middle East and Asia\-Pacific (APAC).In this role, you will work alongside our commercial and technical teams to deliver compelling product demos, support technical evaluations (PoCs), and answer technical questionnaires for enterprise prospects. If you have a solid foundation in cloud infrastructure or Kubernetes, enjoy working with customers, and want to learn how modern AI clusters and cloud economics work at scale, this is an exceptional opportunity to accelerate your career.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Prepare and deliver clear, hands\-on product walkthroughs showing prospective customers how our platform tracks multi\-cloud costs, monitors container spend, and identifies idle infrastructure waste.
* Assist customers during Proof\-of\-Concept stages by helping configure integrations, connecting telemetry feeds (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and validating that data is flowing correctly.
* Complete technical RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, and architecture checklists, coordinating with senior engineering colleagues when deep architectural escalations are needed.
* Shadow discovery conversations with client platform engineers and DevOps leads across the Middle East and APAC to understand their current cloud setup, pain points, and monitoring tools.
* Use APIs and basic scripting to customize demo environments, simulate cost scenarios, and showcase specific customer use cases.
* Proactively use AI assistants and modern productivity tools to draft proposal sections, format data, and speed up turnaround times on customer queries.



**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in technical pre\-sales, technical support, cloud engineering, or customer\-facing solutions engineering.
* Solid practical knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) and core concepts around compute, storage, and networking.
* Practical understanding of Docker and Kubernetes concepts (pods, namespaces, resource requests/limits).
* Familiarity with modern monitoring and metrics tools (such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to run technical presentations and demos for prospective buyers.
* Based in or comfortable supporting accounts across the Middle East (GCC) and APAC time zones.
* A clear drive to master emerging areas like GPU workload economics, modern AI infrastructure, and FinOps.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Basic familiarity with cloud billing concepts (AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, or basic FinOps principles).
* Exposure to basic scripting in
 
 Python, Bash, or SQL to query data or test REST APIs.
* Familiarity with on\-premises data centers, private cloud setups, or power metrics (PUE).
* Exposure to enterprise customers in the GCC or Asia\-Pacific region.



**Why Now** 




 NEXUS is expanding globally. We are actively scaling our footprint across our core international theatres, with APAC and the Middle East representing our most dynamic, rapidly accelerating frontier for AI infrastructure adoption. We are hiring exceptional engineering, operational, and customer\-facing technical talent to drive our organization forward. If you are an autonomous, high\-conviction professional who wants your next decade of work to sit at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and enterprise software at the precise moment the market is being decided — we want to talk to you.
 



 \#NEXUS \#PreSales \#SalesEngineer \#SolutionsEngineer \#CloudInfrastructure \#DevOps \#Kubernetes \#MultiCloud \#APAC \#MiddleEast \#TechHiring \#GlobalTalent \#CareerGrowth

**Telecom Solution Architect / Solution \& Delivery Lead – OSS/BSS**

**Location:** Noida/Pune, India

**Workplace Type:** Onsite

 **About the Role**


We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Senior Telecom Solution Architect / Solution \& Delivery Lead with extensive expertise in both Operations Support Systems (OSS) and Business Support Systems (BSS). This pivotal role requires an individual who can independently lead the entire lifecycle of solutions, from initial concept and presales engagement through to successful end\-to\-end project delivery.  



  

You will be instrumental in shaping and implementing cutting\-edge solutions for telecommunications operators and Communication Service Providers (CSPs), driving innovation and ensuring client satisfaction. This is an opportunity to leverage your deep technical knowledge and leadership skills to make a significant impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Design end\-to\-end OSS/BSS solutions for Telecom Operators/CSPs.
* Drive presales, RFP/RFI, solution proposals, estimations and customer engagements with Sales.
* Independently own project delivery from solution through implementation and go\-live.
* Architect solutions across 4G/5G, Service Assurance, Fulfillment, Provisioning, Orchestration, Inventory, Network Automation, SDN/NFV and Cloud\-native Telecom.
* Drive OSS/BSS modernization and integration using APIs, microservices and TM Forum standards.
* Identify AI/ML, GenAI and AIOps use cases for network automation, service assurance and intelligent telecom operations.
* Lead technical teams and ensure successful delivery, quality and customer satisfaction.

 **Must\-Have**

* 15\+ years of Telecom experience with strong exposure to both OSS and BSS.
* Proven Solution Architecture \+ Presales \+ End\-to\-End Delivery experience.
* Strong knowledge of 5G, OSS/BSS, orchestration, network automation and telecom transformation.
* Experience working with Sales in an Engineering/IT Services or SI environment.
* Strong customer\-facing and technical leadership skills.
* Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI or AIOps in Telecom preferred.

 **Ideal Profile:**

* A senior Telecom technology leader who can architect solutions, drive presales, engage customers and independently own project delivery end\-to\-end.

**We are modernising its Parts and Accessories e\-commerce ecosystem by consolidating multiple legacy platforms into a single, scalable, best\-of\-breed solution. The project focuses on a modern technology stack, flexible site management, improved operational efficiency, and future\-ready scalability, enabling seamless migration of additional e\-commerce experiences. Strong emphasis will be placed on quality assurance, observability, monitoring, and lifecycle management to ensure a reliable, maintainable, and adaptable platform that can evolve with changing business needs.**

 **Responsibilities*** **Own the frontend architecture and technical vision for a scalable e\-commerce platform using Next.js, React.js, and TypeScript.**
* **Design and implement Micro Frontend and Nx monorepo architectures supporting modular, independent development and deployment.**

* **Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, observability, monitoring, SRE dashboards, and alerting.**

* **Evaluate and adopt AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude, while driving technology evaluations, POCs, and continuous modernization.**
* **Provide technical leadership, mentoring, stakeholder collaboration, and risk management, ensuring the architecture supports future e\-commerce integrations and business growth.**

**Overall experience of 10 to 15 years in front end Architecture is must.**

**Technical Skills:**

* **Strong proficiency in Next.js (Latest, preferable Next 14 and above) and React.js.**
* **Have very good exposure on front end architectures.**
* **Have a strong Micro Front End experience**
* **Good at AI tools such as Copilot, Claude, etc,.**
* **Good at CICD pipeline exposure and configuration of alters based on SRE dashboard.**
* Proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* **Experience with server\-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) using Next.js.**
* Familiarity with state management libraries like Redux or Mobx.
* Experience with monorepo approach using Nx
* Knowledge of modern web development tools and technologies (Webpack, Babel, etc.).
* Experience with responsive web design and mobile\-first development.
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and GraphQL.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

 **We offer**  

* Opportunity to work on bleeding\-edge projects
* Work with a highly motivated and dedicated team
* Competitive salary
* Flexible schedule
* Benefits package \- medical insurance, sports
* Corporate social events
* Professional development opportunities

****About SKF****

 SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.

 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in
   

  





**Innovation is the key:**




 We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy\-efficient future where we can all do more with less.
   

  





**Sustainability:**




 At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.
   

  





****About Technology Development****




 As a team, we're responsible for global research, technology development, product development and technology strategy. Our group strategy is that 25 percent of our growth should come from new products. Filling that funnel with new and bold innovation is one of the things that we do. We bring customer value by combining our unique knowledge and technology in products and solutions with sustainability to develop ‘Intelligent \& Clean’ solutions." \- Annika Ölme, CTO and Senior Vice President, Technology Development

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment.
