df35e9a3.title: Product Solution Engineer
df35e9a3.description:
**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 At Vegapay, we’re building the infrastructure powering next\-gen credit programs for banks and fintechs. As a
 *Product Solutions Engineer,* 
 you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and clients \- owning production reliability while solving complex, real\-world fintech problems at scale.
   

  

 This is not a traditional support role. You will be the first line of defense for mission\-critical systems, the go\-to person for debugging deep issues, and a key partner in ensuring our platform runs flawlessly for our banking partners.
   

  

*The Hats You Will Wear*
* Own end\-to\-end production reliability across credit, UPI, ledgering, and reconciliation systems
* Debug complex production issues across services, APIs, and data layers with strong problem\-solving depth
* Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and drive permanent fixes
* Drive incident management rigor including triaging, prioritization, and resolution within SLAs
* Lead post\-incident RCA discussions with clear, actionable insights
* Proactively monitor systems using logs, metrics, and alerts to prevent failures
* Work directly with B2B clients (banks/partners) to communicate issues and build trust
* Create and maintain playbooks/runbooks for faster issue resolution
* Support product launches and releases, ensuring production readiness and smooth rollouts


**The Perfect Fit**
* 4 \- 6 years of experience in B2B SaaS / Fintech / Payments companies
* B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong hands\-on experience in SQL (joins, aggregations, debugging data mismatches)
* Solid understanding of APIs and request/response flows; experience with tools like Postman
* Experience with logs and observability tools (Kibana / ELK stack)
* Proven ability to debug issues in distributed systems
* Familiarity with incident management and ticketing tools (JIRA or similar)
* Exposure to monitoring tools (Grafana / Prometheus)
* Understanding of system design basics (microservices, queues, retries, failure handling)
* Working knowledge of databases


*Your Edge Over the Rest*
* Experience in payments / banking / fintech systems
* Exposure to UPI, card networks (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), ledger systems, or reconciliation flows
* You don’t just fix issues you prevent them
* You combine deep debugging with sharp stakeholder communication


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
   

  

 This is where we come in.
   

  

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
   

  

**The Opportunity Ahead**
* Solve real\-world fintech problems at scale with high ownership and impact
* Work directly with top banks and cutting\-edge credit infrastructure
* Fast\-paced, high\-learning environment with strong growth opportunities

e74ef81e.title: Solution Architect
e74ef81e.description:
**Company Description**
 Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
   

  

 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
   

  

 Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical\-first: you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical\-path features), while partnering with a global, cross\-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI\-powered development practices—including spec\-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI\-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Hands\-On)**
* Architecture \+ Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event\-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well\-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent\-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front\-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data\-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro\-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event\-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication \& Authorization: Implement end\-to\-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token\-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant\-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service\-to\-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.
* AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows—using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines—with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for regulated environments.
* Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices—spec\-driven workflows, AI\-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation—to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance.


**Patterns We Expect You to Use**
* Event\-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate)
* Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure\-mode design, consistency tradeoffs)
* Domain\-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti\-corruption layers)
* Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks.


**AI\-Enabled Delivery Expectations**
* Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support).
* Comfortable using a spec\-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices—spec\-driven development, AI\-assisted coding, and agent\-based automation—as standard ways of working.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope).
* Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross\-border considerations).
* Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud\-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI\-enabled features and agent\-based automation.
* Strong experience architecting Next.js and/or React applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience with event\-driven and distributed system design and production operations.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, spec\-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI\-assisted delivery workflows.
* Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns.
* Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates).
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics.
* Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus.
* Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e.g., using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks).
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.


**Additional Information**

* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

f18e6cef.description:
**Who is ERM?**
**ERM** 
 is a leading global sustainability consulting firm, committed for nearly 50 years to helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges. We bring together a diverse and inclusive community of experts across regions and disciplines, providing a truly multicultural environment that fosters collaboration, professional growth, and meaningful global exposure. As a people\-first organization, ERM values well\-being, career development, and the power of collective expertise to drive sustainable impact for our clients—and the planet.
   

  

**Introducing our new Global Delivery Centre (GDC)**
 Our
 **Global Delivery Centre (GDC)** 
 in India is a unified platform designed to deliver high\-value services and solutions to ERM’s global clientele. By centralizing key business and consulting functions, we streamline operations, optimize service delivery, and enable our teams to focus on what matters most—advising clients on sustainability challenges with agility and innovation. Through the GDC, you will collaborate with international teams, leverage emerging technologies, and further enhance ERM’s commitment to excellence—amplifying our shared mission to make a lasting, positive impact.
   

  

**Job Objective**
 A Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, optimizing, and delivering comprehensive technology solutions that align with business objectives. They play a key role in defining the software development architecture and leveraging cloud technologies to enhance scalability, performance, and efficiency. The Solutions Architect collaborates with senior technical leaders, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to ensure the successful implementation of technology strategies in large organizational environments.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture: Designs and delivers scalable, high\-performance, and secure technology solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
* Technology Optimization: Continuously evaluates and improves technology processes to ensure efficiency, maintainability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Collaboration with Stakeholders: Works closely with product managers, software engineers, DevOps teams, and business leaders to define and refine technical requirements and align solutions with organizational goals.
* Technology Selection \& Integration: Assesses, selects, and integrates the best\-fit technologies, frameworks, and tools, ensuring alignment with architectural best practices and industry standards.

c53d9c14.title: Associate Customer Program Manager (EG)
c53d9c14.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**


MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.


**\*\*Work Hours:** **9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)\*\***


**F****ictiv exists to help product innovators create**


Fictiv is a global manufacturing company that simplifies sourcing for custom manufacturing, from prototype to low\-volume production. Through its highly\-vetted manufacturing network, AI\-powered technology platform, and global operations centers across the USA, Mexico, India, and China, Fictiv delivers fast, high\-quality custom manufacturing services from quote to delivery. Fictiv’s capabilities span the full mechanical bill of materials, including Injection Molding, Compression Molding, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Die Casting, and Sheet Metal. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 30 million commercial and prototype parts for early\-stage companies and large enterprises alike, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.


**Impact in this Role**


Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and finding creative solutions? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, non\-traditional environment, we want YOU on our team!


In your role as **Associate Customer Program Manager**, you will be working directly with our US\-based customers, and you’ll be using your agility, problem\-solving skills, and customer service advocacy to help our customers increase the velocity and quality of products delivered. You will collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to resolve customer pain points, address customer needs, and help manage customer projects end to end. You will support multiple customers across a variety of manufacturing orders to be fulfilled in different regions around the world.


**Work Hours:** 9**:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)**  

  

This role follow a hybrid work schedule \- 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote


**What you will be doing**


* **Customer Management:** You will be our customers’ best ally at Fictiv. Work closely with our customers to ensure a seamless and high\-quality experience. Nurture relationships and resolve issues to help drive customer loyalty.
* **Case management:** Concurrently manage a variety of manufacturing orders with multiple customers and the internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve top user requests to address their product development needs and meet customer expectations for timing and quality.
* **Communication:** Gather, interpret, and communicate engineering, design, manufacturing, and logistics requirements to ensure the orders will be delivered on time and in full
* **Collaboration**: Collaborate with sales and the manufacturing operations teams to ensure successful delivery to the customer and advocate on their behalf \- through the project lifecycle, including post\-delivery exceptions.
* **Program Managemen**t: Manage projects with top\-down oversight throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Identify improvement areas and collaborate with the cross\-functional team to prioritize and define solutions to increase our efficiency.

**Desired Traits**


* **Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA required.**
* **4\+ years of experience in program management, project management, supply chain or customer\-facing operations roles.**
* **Experience supporting NPI, low\-volume production, or rapid prototyping programs.**
* **PMP/project management certification and understanding of project management/operations knowledge preferred.**
* **The work is fast\-paced** \- you will be working in an operations environment with tight deadlines and high standards. You will need to be organized with good time management, prioritization skills and great attention to detail.
* **We obsess over our customers** \- you will need to be personable and have outstanding communications skills (both written and verbal) and be able to adapt your communication style effectively. Must be fluent in written and spoken English. Proven experience working directly with US\-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred
* **This role requires a self\-starter mentality**. We want you to be excited by a hands\-on, high\-performing, results\-oriented role and driven to exceed expectations for our clients. Accountability is everything; you say what you do and do what you say.
* **Aligned with our culture centered around continuous learning** \- bring passion to learn about the manufacturing ecosystem and the New Product Development process.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

404e275e.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
404e275e.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
 This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
   

  

 The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.


**Skills**
* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

The ideal candidate will be capable of managing multiple workstreams, driving engineering teams, resolving technical and delivery challenges, and ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and compliance requirements.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of IAM and CIAM programs, from requirements and planning through implementation and production rollout
* Manage technical delivery across Okta, IAM, and identity security initiatives
* Work with architects and engineering teams to define scalable identity and access management solutions
* Oversee implementation of SSO, MFA, federation, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management capabilities
* Drive Okta integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, directories, and customer\-facing platforms
* Coordinate CIAM initiatives focused on secure and seamless customer identity experiences
* Translate business and security requirements into actionable technical delivery plans
* Manage project scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation
* Lead cross\-functional engineering and technology teams across multiple workstreams
* Facilitate architecture discussions, technical reviews, design decisions, and implementation planning
* Monitor delivery progress and proactively address technical, operational, and resource\-related blockers
* Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure identity solutions meet organizational security and governance standards
* Establish delivery processes, engineering standards, documentation, and operational best practices
* Coordinate testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation activities
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior stakeholders and leadership
* Identify opportunities to improve IAM platforms, automation, operational efficiency, and overall identity security posture
* Mentor technical teams and promote strong engineering, security, and delivery practices


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, engineering management, solution delivery, or a related technical leadership role
* Strong hands\-on understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and enterprise identity architectures
* Proven experience with Okta and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) implementations
* Strong knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, MFA, federation, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management
* Experience integrating identity platforms with enterprise applications, APIs, directories, and cloud environments
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, access governance, identity security, and compliance principles
* Proven experience managing complex technical programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders
* Strong project planning, risk management, dependency management, and delivery governance skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, architects, security teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges
* Experience working in Agile or other modern software delivery environments
* Strong ownership, decision\-making, stakeholder\-management, and leadership capabilities
* Ability to balance technical depth, delivery execution, business priorities, security, and user experience
* Relevant IAM, Okta, cybersecurity, or cloud certifications would be an advantage

3a7d816c.title: Service Delivery Manager
3a7d816c.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description \-**
* Partnering with platform infrastructure leadership, all functions within, and I\&O leadership on financial analysis and tracking efficiency initiatives across the group. Coordinate with the business office concerning budget and efficiency savings.
* Collaborate with I\&O Product leads on executing strategic initiatives aimed at cost reduction and increased efficiencies aligned with strategic business goals.
* Responsible for the transition and transformation of vendor managed services.
* Drive governance across all towers including Hosting, Backup, Storage, Monitoring, Automation, and Batch Services, and support annual regulatory audits across all functions in I\&O.
* Act as primary liaison between EY product owners, managed service providers and internal stakeholder groups. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless execution of services and resolve any service issues.
* Monitor service health horizontally across all teams, escalate issues as necessary, and ensure root cause analysis and permanent fixes are implemented across all towers within Platform Infrastructure.
* Manage contract deliverables, including reporting, service reviews, KPI dashboards, compliance checks, and transformation milestones. Manage monthly invoices and escalations.
* Coordinate audits and compliance reporting in partnership with EY Security, Risk, and Infosec teams. Act as a liaison between I\&O, Info Sec and Managed service provider to ensure governance is executed efficiently.
* Execute special strategic requests across platform infrastructure in partnership with tower, BAU team, and Kyndryl delivery team.
* Conduct operational governance reviews—weekly, monthly, and quarterly—with vendor and internal EY stakeholders.
* Track and resolve contractual non\-compliance, manage disputes, and collaborate with legal or procurement departments when necessary.
* Uses Agile and DevOps approaches to improve flow, increase delivery speed, and strengthen collaboration across teams.
* Manages budgets, costs, and service related risks to support informed decisions and predictable service outcomes.
* Analyse third\-party as well as internal processes, and create strategies for service delivery optimization
* Knowledge about AI, automation, Power BI/Power App dashboard development and Copilot Integration


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

a27ed2fe.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
a27ed2fe.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2\)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions.  As a Manager in Enterprise Technology Solutions, you will play a pivotal role in consulting services for business applications, focusing on optimizing operational efficiency for clients. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Cyber, Data \& Tech Risk practice, you will focus on validating compliance and enhancing security within Oracle applications, analyzing client requirements, implementing security measures, and offering guidance for compliance with regulatory standards.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will be responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully.  In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will address conflicts or issues, engaging in conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.

* Leading the implementation of Oracle compliance and security measures to protect sensitive data and maintain regulatory standards
* Analyzing client requirements to develop tailored solutions for optimizing operational efficiency within Oracle applications
* Guiding teams in the strategic planning and execution of compliance and security initiatives
* Providing training and support to clients for seamless integration and utilization of business applications
* Developing and overseeing compliance programs to mitigate risks and enhance security frameworks
* Collaborating with client leadership to validate quality, timelines, and deliverables

* Addressing conflicts and engaging in critical conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
* Embracing technology and innovation to improve service delivery and encourage team adoption of new tools

 What You Must Have

* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Analytics, Business Administration/Management, Business Analytics, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Computer and Information Science, Economics, Finance, Information CyberSecurity, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Risk Management, Statistics, Systems Engineering
* At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Security, Identity, Governance, Risk Management, or related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) security domains

2a121f9d.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
2a121f9d.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Technical Program Manager
Overview  

The Mastercard Core Payments \- Network \& Digital Payment Services (part of Product and Engineering) team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive delivery to move our eCommerce product and platform strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. You will manage the implementation of multiple projects/programs ensuring product/engineering strategy goals and requirements are delivered with quality.  

As Lead TPM, you will interact with product managers, software development managers, developers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the Product and Engineering organization to deliver complex projects and programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop program execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and balance business needs versus technical constraints.  

The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.  

* Responsible for planning, execution, and delivery, from inception to completion, for an existing technology product or program.
* Proactively manages the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering work though the engineering team and all dependent organizations.
* Reports on progress, ensuring dependencies are covered.
* Operates between teams and architectures overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery


Responsibilities  

* Plan and manage a group of related technology projects or activities in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Deep understanding of the design approaches and technologies utilized in your area
* Focus on the customer experience, the build and delivery processes and the problems to be solved
* Work across multiple scrum teams (may be cross\-cutting across products, scrum teams, and/or technologies or work may be vertically focused on a single product or feature set)
* Align dependent organizations and remove/mitigate all blocking issues
* Work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers and customers
* Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance as needed because the product and delivery strategy is defined. The design is not.
* Deep understanding of the business and technical requirements for the solutions being built
* Understand the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who must build, maintain, and operate the system for the life of the system
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs
* Help customers and the engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all of the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
* Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels
* Write documentation as required
* Partner with industry vendors that provide technology or user experience design components that support our architecture and work with vendors on our implementation plans and roadmaps identifying partnership opportunities to increase our development velocity and our learnings
* Communicate role up of project issues and status in a concise, accurate, and professional manner for senior leadership consumption, escalating blocking issues when appropriate
* Communicate progress, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, identify, assess, track and mitigate issues/risks at multiple levels
* Work across teams to optimize processes
* Regularly review metrics and proactively seek out new and improved data/mechanisms for visibility ensuring your program stays aligned with organization objectives


Skills/Abilities  

* Demonstrated ability to operate with independence and autonomy
* Experience defining and building cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale with a deep understanding of those platforms’ capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
* Experience working on programs to define and build cloud\-native software products as a platform at scale
* Technical capability to effectively solve software engineering challenges, communicate with engineers, scope technical programs, and identify technical risks.
* Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platform’s capabilities and underlying technologies.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs.
* Proven track record of data driven decision\-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
* Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers
* Can communicate to executives, peers, and staff with impact, eloquence, and authenticity
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Huge plus if you have expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, serverless technology, CI/CD, NoSQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model
* 12\+years technical program delivery experience including time developing and testing software


Education:
  

* Bachelors in engineering, computer science or related discipline.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

0b5315d4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
0b5315d4.description:
**Overview**
 GitHub is seeking a passionate, driven, and collaborative Senior TPM to drive the GitHub Enterprise Servier (GHES) release process. This includes OS and container builds across the platform, infrastructure, and application layers; package generation and certification; integration test environments; and distribution of release artifacts through Azure and other clouds. In this role, you will define operational priorities for the team, coordinate execution across a complex release surface, and partner across engineering organizations to ensure GHES ships as a high\-quality, secure, and dependable appliance for enterprise customers.
   

  

 You will partner with stakeholders to deliver solutions that strengthen our security posture and elevate service resiliency and quality. Additionally, you will coordinate with engineers across the organization to monitor progress, resolve blockers, and provide status updates to the leadership team.
   

  

 Our team is small, efficient, and engineering\-focused, thriving in a fast\-paced environment. We are looking for a Senior TPM who embraces new challenges and adapts quickly to evolving programs. To support multiple initiatives simultaneously, you will leverage AI to boost productivity and continuously seek opportunities to enhance engineering efficiency through agentic AI\-based solutions.
   

  

 To be successful in the role, the ideal candidate will require strong interpersonal skills, influencing without authority, drive for results, and collaboration in addition to a proven track record in technical program management and operational excellence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Technical Program Manager Role encompasses a broad scope including:
   

  

* Drive execution across build, package generation, validation, certification, and customer delivery workflows for GHES releases.
* Establish and drive standards for release reliability, observability, compliance, and operational excellence across build, release, and certification workflows.
* Set investment priorities for the GHES Release team, balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term improvements in reliability, efficiency, and engineering velocity.
* Ensure strong operational ownership of release infrastructure, including clear accountability, effective incident response, and continuous improvement following critical issues.
* Drive and deliver security and compliance requirements.
* Negotiate requirements with the central teams (SMEs).
* Understand best practices and available tooling to improve service resiliency and quality.
* Influence and drive adoption of quality best practices and standards.
* Drive onboarding to central infra services and, tooling.
* Track various metrics across broad set of services.
* Drive tooling and infra feature design and implementation.
* Identify new opportunities and work with the central teams to supplement existing quality standards.
* Deliver technical and high\-level presentations in various forums.
* Drive multiple projects at any given time.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Program Manager or in a technical role with systems experience.
* 3\+ years of experience working in the Cloud domain.
* 3\+ year of experience in management of complex cross\-group, cross\-business, cross\-disciplinary projects.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong technical problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Good understanding of cloud services best practices.
* Good understanding of cloud architecture, telemetry, and monitoring systems.
* Experience with high\-availability systems and services resiliency.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and drive results across teams.
* Negotiation skills to drive repair items/investments with engineering managers. Knows trade\-offs.
* 4\-years degree in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/EE or equivalent experience.


**Requirements**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.

bbc5f1cd.description:

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with data warehouse design and exploratory data analysis.
* Experience with hardware manufacturing test industry and business operations.
* Experience with F1\-SQL and AI/Machine Learning.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* 5 years of experience in architecting data engineering, data warehousing, data analytics, business intelligence, visualization, and complex data solutions using SQL and Python.
* Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI.
* Full stack development using Angular and Javascripts.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The Infrastructure Supply Chain and Manufacturing (ISM) Product Operations team aims to take an AI first approach to digitize and automate different aspects of product operations. We focus on improving efficiency by automating processes, providing users with tools and applications to maximize their value while launching and sustaining Google cloud hardware in production.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with engineering and product development teams to understand business requirements. Engage with managers from cross functional teams to develop solutions tailored to their unique business processes.
* Analyze manufacturing data and other relevant data sources to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for optimization. Develop insightful reports that clearly communicate key metrics to stakeholders.
* Create and maintain robust, user\-friendly products that provide real\-time visibility into key operational metrics. Implement proactive alerting mechanisms to notify management of potential issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and workflows. Collaborate with relevant teams to develop tools and scripts that streamline processes and improve efficiency.
* Translate complex technical and engineering issues into clear, concise summaries that are easily understood by management and cross\-functional teams. Facilitate communication between different teams and ensure tight coordination.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution** 




  





 At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work.
 



  





**Why Skan AI** 




  





 We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
 



  





 Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
 



  





 Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
 



  





 AI Solutions is our global post\-sales and professional\-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end\-to\-end. We are AI\-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.
 



  





**The role.** 
 Set the technical bar for AI\-native delivery and be the first line of defense on every solution we build. You own architecture and solutioning end\-to\-end — from pre\-sales through delivery — and you see the whole picture: not just what the customer asked for, but why they bought us and what they actually need. You translate wants into needs, frame the real problem, and drive it from idea to implementation to impact. This is an AI\-native operational\-intelligence architect, not a traditional workflow or BPM architect.
 



  





**What you own** 



* End\-to\-end, AI\-native architecture and integration design for customer engagements — the build patterns the whole delivery team works to.
* The big picture — understanding why the customer is buying Skan, shaping the real problem behind the stated request, and designing to the outcome.
* Pre\-sales solutioning and the architecture gate\-review before anything reaches the customer; you are the quality bar.
* Reusable reference architectures, patterns and standards fed into the Center of Excellence.
* Architectures grounded in operational telemetry — the digital twin of work — and built for continuous optimization.
* Agentic systems design — perception, reasoning and planning; bounded autonomy, contextual memory, multi\-agent orchestration and runtime observability.



**What we look for** 



* Thinks in systems, not workflows — reasons about enterprise operational behavior, not requirements → approvals → implementation.
* Real agentic depth (well beyond 'instruct the agent' / 'let the agent decide') and telemetry\-native intelligence design.
* Sees needs behind wants — frames the business problem and drives idea → implementation → impact.
* Fluent in AI economics — inferencing, token and GPU modeling; scalability, hallucination\-containment and auditability tradeoffs.

 Our past is full of iconic moments — but our future is going to spark many more. Our brands — Gap, Banana Republic, Old Navy and Athleta — have dressed people from all walks of life and all kinds of families, all over the world, for every occasion for more than 50 years.
   

  

 But we’re more than the clothes that we make. We know that business can and should be a force for good, and it’s why we work hard to make product that makes people feel good, inside and out. It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super\-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Staff Architect, you are a high\-impact individual contributor responsible for designing robust and scalable solutions within a domain stream. You bring deep technical and functional expertise and partner with cross\-functional teams to define and implement architecture that supports business and technical objectives. Department: Enterprise ArchitectureRole : Senior Staff Enterprise Solution ArchitectEmployment Type : Full\- TimeLocation: Hyderabad, India (HDC)This role is focused on hands\-on solution design, documentation, and delivery — with increasing influence across products, platforms, and governing teams.You bring deep expertise in retail and consumer goods, partnering with cross\-functional business, product, and engineering teams to define and implement architecture that is robust, scalable, and aligned to both business and technical objectives. You serve as a bridge between architecture and engineering leadership, ensuring consistency, quality, and performance of solutions. As AI reshapes how software is designed and delivered, you will play an active role in embedding AI\-driven thinking into architecture practices and championing adoption across your domain.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Solution design \& documentation**
 Design and document end\-to\-end solutions for key initiatives within your domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business needs.
   

  

**Project architecture leadership**
 Lead architecture for individual projects and features, guiding engineering teams through solution execution and well\-reasoned technical trade\-offs
   

  

**Cross\-functional collaboration**
 Partner with strategy teams, product managers, architects and engineers to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable architecture complaining to EA guidelines. Provide architectural input across multiple simultaneous initiatives.
   

  

**Quality, feasibility \& integration alignment**
 Ensure technical feasibility, performance, and integration alignment of solutions with adjacent systems and domains. Participate in defining, enhancing and ensuring design and code reviews to uphold architectural quality.
   

  

**Architecture framework \& reusability**
 Contribute to the evolution of architecture frameworks, reusable components, and reference implementations that raise the bar across the engineering organization.
   

  

**Planning, estimation \& technology evaluation**
 Engage in early project planning and estimation through an architecture lens. Stay current with emerging technologies and help evaluate their applicability within your domain.
   

  

**AI ADOPTION**
* Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities into enterprise domain solutions to enhance business value and operational efficiency.
* Serve as a strategic advocate for responsible, ethical, and compliant AI adoption across the domain architecture landscape.
* Lead the execution and advancement of enterprise architecture strategies in alignment with the vision and direction established by Principal Architects.


**ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATION**
 Hands\-on solution design and delivery within a domain stream. Operationalizes enterprise guidance into project\-level architecture.
   

  

**Alignment with Principal \& Sr Principal Architects** 
**:** 
 Engage regularly with Principal and Senior Principal Architects to ensure domain\-level solutions are grounded in enterprise architecture strategy. Consume and operationalize enterprise standards, patterns, and guardrails into project\-level designs, and surface domain\-specific insights that inform broader strategic decisions.
   

  

**Cross\-domain architecture reviews** 
**:** 
 Participate in architecture review boards and cross\-domain design forums facilitated by Principal Architects. Represent your domain's perspective, highlight integration touch\-points, and collaborate on solutions that span multiple domain streams.
   

  

**Feedback loop \& pattern sharing** 
**:** 
 Maintain a continuous feedback loop with the EA team — sharing reusable patterns, lessons learned, and implementation experiences from domain delivery that can be elevated into enterprise\-wide frameworks and reference architectures.
   

  

**Strategic roadmap contribution** 
**:** 
 Contribute domain\-level input to enterprise technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives led by Senior Principal Architects. Help bridge the gap between long\-term architectural vision and near\-term delivery realities within your domain.
   

  

**SaaS Vendor Product Evaluations:** 
 Collaborate with Principal Architects and product stakeholders to ensure recommended SaaS choices are grounded in both domain delivery needs and long\-term enterprise architecture direction.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 Seasoned technologist with strong architectural thinking and a solid background in hands\-on software or platform engineering.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

d8f9e56d.title: Security Architect (Bangalore, India)
d8f9e56d.description:
**About AiPrise**
-----------------


AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80\+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI\-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a Security Architect to own the security architecture of our platform end to end, across infrastructure, applications, and APIs, and to be hands\-on in making it better. This is a builder’s role, not a paper one. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineers to find and fix real security issues, set the standards that keep them fixed, and translate a demanding regulatory landscape into practical controls the team can actually ship.


You will also be the technical face of security in the rooms that matter: with auditors, with enterprise customers’ security teams, and with regulators. You will join as an individual contributor with the depth to lead by doing, and as the security team grows you will have the opportunity to build and manage a team of your own.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the security architecture across cloud infrastructure, applications, and APIs, and evolve it as the platform grows into new products and regions.
* Work directly with engineers to identify, prioritize, and remediate security issues in infrastructure, application code, and APIs, reviewing designs, pairing on fixes, and validating that they hold.
* Perform threat modeling and security design reviews for new services and significant changes, and embed security into the development lifecycle (secure coding standards, code review, CI/CD controls, dependency and container security).
* Define and maintain security standards, reference architectures, and hardening baselines, and drive their adoption across engineering.
* Lead and coordinate security testing, including penetration tests, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking, and hold findings to closure within defined timelines.
* Translate industry and regulatory security and privacy requirements into concrete technical and organizational controls, and keep them current as obligations change.
* Own the technical side of audits and assessments, including industry and certification audits (for example SOC 2 and ISO 27001\), enterprise\-customer security reviews, and regulatory reviews, covering evidence, control mapping, and remediation of findings.
* Represent security in customer\-facing conversations, including security questionnaires, due\-diligence calls, and trust discussions with prospects, customers, and their auditors.
* Partner with the privacy and data\-protection function to ensure controls meet GDPR and other applicable data protection requirements, with particular care for personal and biometric data.
* Contribute to incident readiness and response, including detection, investigation, and post\-incident improvement.
* As the team grows, mentor and eventually manage junior security engineers, setting technical direction, reviewing work, and developing the team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 7 to 9 years of experience in security engineering, security architecture, or a closely related field, with a track record of securing production systems at scale.
* Genuine hands\-on technical depth. You can read and reason about application code, cloud infrastructure, and API design, and work with engineers to fix issues rather than only flagging them.
* Strong command of cloud security, including network segmentation, IAM, secrets and key management, and workload and container security, along with infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Deep application and API security knowledge, including the common vulnerability classes (for example access\-control flaws, injection, and SSRF), secure design patterns, authentication and authorization, and secure SDLC practices.
* Solid, current understanding of industry and regulatory security and privacy requirements, such as SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, and related frameworks, and the judgment to apply them proportionately.
* Demonstrated experience handling audits and assessments of multiple kinds (certification, enterprise\-client, and regulatory), including preparing evidence and driving findings to closure.
* Excellent stakeholder and customer\-facing communication. You can explain security clearly and credibly to engineers, executives, auditors, and customers alike.
* Sound risk judgment. You can balance security, business needs, and delivery, and make defensible decisions with incomplete information.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in fintech, regtech, identity verification, or another regulated, data\-sensitive domain.
* Experience handling personal or biometric and identity data and the associated privacy obligations.
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability research.
* Familiarity with privacy frameworks and regulations beyond GDPR (for example regional data protection laws), and with DevSecOps practices and tooling.
* Relevant certifications (for example CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, or privacy certifications such as CIPP or CIPT) are valued, but hands\-on capability matters more.
* Experience mentoring or leading engineers, with an interest in building and managing a team.

**Growth and Leadership Track**
-------------------------------


This role is designed to grow. You will start as a hands\-on individual contributor with real ownership of our security architecture. As the security function expands, you will have a clear path into leadership: building, mentoring, and managing a team while continuing to set technical direction.

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* Introductory Discussion (Engineering Manager) – 45 mins
* Security Deep Dive \& Practical Assessment – 90 mins
* Security Deep Dive – 60 mins
* Founder \& Culture Alignment – 45 mins


Compensation Range: ₹30L \- ₹50L

34aaedb4.title: Solutions Engineer
34aaedb4.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.
 


  


**Looking for** 



  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role
* Enough hands\-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.
 


  


*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer\-facing engineering roles here.*
