b22eb034.title: Architect
b22eb034.description:
**Senior Data \& Integration Architect** 




**Job Description** 




 The ideal candidate is a senior integration engineer/architect who remains hands\-on while providing architectural and technical leadership. The candidate should be comfortable moving between code\-level troubleshooting, solution design, production\-readiness assessment and client conversations.
 



**Experience** 



* Typically, 8\+ years of software, backend or integration engineering experience.
* At least 3\-5 years of experience designing or leading event\-driven and API\-based enterprise integrations.
* Prior experience functioning as a Technical Lead, Integration Lead, Senior Backend Engineer or Solution Architect is strongly preferred.



**Technical Stack** 



* **Programming:** 
 Python, SQL, REST APIs
* **Data Platforms:** 
 Snowflake, relational databases, data modeling
* **Integration:** 
 Salesforce, enterprise system integrations, API integrations
* **Data Engineering:** 
 Dataiku, ETL/ELT, data quality, data validation
* **Cloud:** 
 AWS
* **AWS Services:** 
 API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, IAM, Secrets Manager
* **Architecture:** 
 Event\-driven architecture, microservices, asynchronous processing, concurrency, scalability, fault tolerance
* **Testing:** 
 pytest, unit testing, functional testing, contract testing, integration testing, automated validation frameworks
* **DevOps:** 
 CI/CD, deployment automation, monitoring, logging, production troubleshooting
* **Engineering:** 
 API design, performance optimization, idempotency, error handling, distributed systems



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop event\-driven, asynchronous and distributed system integrations.
* Design and develop scalable Python\-based APIs and integration services.
* Define source\-of\-truth, data ownership and conflict\-resolution rules across participating systems.
* Design and review REST APIs, webhooks, event\-processing services and Snowflake data components.
* Ensure that integrations correctly handle duplicate events, simultaneous updates, out\-of\-order events and partial failures.
* Implement or guide the implementation of idempotency, retry, timeout, dead\-letter and replay mechanisms.
* Evaluate system behaviour under concurrent processing and high transaction volumes.
* Develop monitoring, logging, alerting and reconciliation controls to identify records that are out of sync.
* Guide and mentor junior engineers through solution design, development, troubleshooting and deployment.
* Partner with business analysts to translate conceptual requirements and business rules into implementable technical designs.
* Lead technical discussions with clients and clearly communicate architectural decisions, risks, dependencies and trade\-offs.
* Create and maintain architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data contracts and operational documentation.
* Support production troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis and continuous platform improvement.

992bf3c3.title: Lead Specialist,Technical Architect
992bf3c3.description:
**Description** 




 Pearson is the world’s leading learning company, helping people of all ages make progress in their lives through education. We deliver high\-quality content, assessments, and digital services to learners, educators, and institutions globally.
 



 Our Team is responsible for the delivery of nearly 4 million examination results per annum, including A\-Level, GCSE, BTEC and T\-levels for students in UK and International centres. Our in\-house systems process every learner from registration to marking and certification, in a highly regulated business. We currently operate a hybrid estate of predominantly bespoke systems, with an ongoing strategic transformation programme to migrate from on\-prem to cloud based, cost effective, scalable, and resilient services.
   

  





**About the Role** 




 This role is focused on building and evolving the cloud\-based integration capabilities supporting the Azure Technical Hub. You will take technical ownership of the architecture, design and implementation of integration solutions and supporting engineering capabilities, leading engineers and delivery partners through detailed design, development, testing, deployment, production readiness and ongoing evolution of the platform.
 



 This is a highly hands\-on technical leadership role combining architecture with implementation. You will be expected to contribute directly to complex development work, review production code, troubleshoot difficult integration and performance issues, make detailed technical decisions and provide day\-to\-day technical direction to engineers. The successful candidate will be accountable for evolving the Technical Hub architecture and translating it into a robust, scalable and production\-ready implementation, driving the solution through to successful delivery.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Take technical ownership of the architecture, design, implementation and production readiness of Azure Technical Hub integration solutions and supporting engineering capabilities, leading engineers and delivery partners through to successful delivery.
* Design and implement Azure\-based integration solutions using API, event\-driven and asynchronous messaging patterns, selecting appropriate integration approaches based on functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Define and govern integration patterns, API contracts and standards, event schemas, message contracts, CDC and event publishing patterns.
* Act as the senior hands\-on technical authority for the integration engineering team, making detailed implementation decisions, resolving complex technical issues, reviewing code and providing day\-to\-day technical leadership and mentoring to engineers.
* Define and govern standards for retries, dead\-letter handling, replay, idempotency, observability and operational resilience.
* Provide architectural oversight and review integration designs across internal teams and suppliers, ensuring consistency with agreed technical standards and engineering best practices.
* Drive technical excellence, performance, scalability and engineering quality across Technical Hub integration solutions.
* Provide hands\-on technical ownership of CI/CD and deployment automation for integration services, including Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Azure DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent technologies. Be comfortable troubleshooting and evolving existing pipelines and deployment automation where required.
* Support the operational lifecycle of cloud integration services, including releases, environment configuration, platform upgrades and troubleshooting of deployment, networking and security issues.
* Work closely with Data Architects to ensure enterprise data models are implemented consistently within integration solutions.
  


  


**Required Skills and Experience** 



  

  
* Proven experience as a hands\-on Technical Architect, Integration Architect, Lead Integration Engineer or similar technical leadership role, with demonstrable experience architecting, designing, building and taking enterprise cloud integration solutions into production.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns across synchronous APIs, asynchronous messaging and event\-driven integration, with the ability to select appropriate patterns based on solution requirements.
* Strong software engineering background with recent hands\-on experience developing enterprise integration solutions using C\#/.NET and Azure integration services. Strong Java experience may also be considered where accompanied by substantial hands\-on Azure integration experience.
* Strong experience designing and implementing API\-based integrations using Azure API Management, with a good understanding of API security, policies, versioning, routing and operational considerations.
* Strong hands\-on experience designing and implementing Azure integration solutions using Azure Service Bus, including topics, subscriptions, sessions, message settlement, duplicate detection and dead\-letter handling, with practical experience of Azure Functions, Azure SQL Managed Instance and related Azure integration services.
* Strong experience designing event\-driven integration solutions, including event schemas, message contracts, Change Data Capture (CDC), Outbox patterns, event publishing and resilient messaging.
* Practical experience with CDC\-based integration and associated processing patterns such as checkpointing, batching, replay and recovery.
* Strong practical understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous messaging patterns, including message ordering, delivery guarantees, eventual consistency, retries, dead\-letter queues, replay, checkpointing, idempotency, duplicate processing, failure recovery, observability and operational resilience.
* Experience designing, performance\-testing and tuning high\-volume integration workloads, including throughput, latency, batching, back\-pressure, scaling and recovery from processing backlogs.
* Strong practical experience with CI/CD, Git/GitHub and automated deployment pipelines using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, together with working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent technologies.
* Good understanding of Azure networking, security and identity for cloud integration solutions, including Managed Identity, Entra ID, RBAC, secrets management and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Demonstrable recent hands\-on engineering experience, with the ability to work directly with production code and personally design, develop, troubleshoot and optimise complex enterprise integration solutions rather than operating solely in an architecture or governance capacity.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and work effectively across architecture and engineering teams.
  


  


**Highly Desirable** 



  

  
* Experience delivering Technical Hub, Integration Hub, API Gateway or other shared integration platforms.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, while maintaining appropriate code quality, security, testing and technical governance.
* Experience working across both Azure and AWS cloud environments, including practical exposure to AWS integration services such as Lambda, DMS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge and Aurora (PostgreSQL/MySQL).
* Experience with additional Azure integration services such as Azure Data Factory and Event Grid.
* Experience working within large\-scale cloud transformation programmes involving multiple teams and suppliers.
* Experience working in highly regulated enterprise environments.
  


  


  

  





**Who we are:** 




 At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.  


As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.  


Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.  


The Role  
Managed Services is provided to our R\&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.  


Our Managed Services Team comprises 90\+ consultants in Europe, of which 5\+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.

As a Safety Consultant, you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.  


To thrive in this role, you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .

Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction  
Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set  
Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

Ability to travel for about \~ 25% of the project time

Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success  
Nice to Have  
Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor  
Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications  
Life science, computer science, or related degree  
SaaS/Cloud experience  
Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation  
Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)

55f42dbc.title: FW Architect Manager (Principal Firmware Architect)
55f42dbc.description:
**Job Summary**


Telit Cinterion is seeking a hands\-on Firmware Architect to lead firmware architecture and technical planning for IoT Solutions products across Telit’s connected device portfolio and customer\-specific programs. This role will define scalable firmware architectures for MCU\-based embedded products, guide firmware execution from a technical perspective, and translate customer requirements into clear technical direction for the development teams.


The ideal candidate combines deep embedded firmware expertise with customer\-facing communication skills, strong architecture judgment, and the ability to lead engineers through complex tradeoffs involving cost, schedule, power, performance, security, manufacturability, and long\-term maintainability.

  

**Objectives \& Responsibilities**


* Own firmware architecture for Telit Cinterion IoT products and customer programs, primarily across cellular IOT Devices including asset trackers, telematics, embedded modems, gateways and routers.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership for firmware design, implementation, bring\-up, debugging, integration, and root\-cause analysis in embedded C/C\+\+ environments.
* Translate customer requirements, field issues, and technical scoping inputs into clear firmware requirements and architecture direction.
* Guide internal and partner engineering teams through architecture documents, interface definitions, design reviews, implementation guidance, and acceptance criteria.
* Architect wireless and device\-to\-cloud capabilities involving cellular, Wi\-Fi, BLE, GNSS, MQTT/HTTP(S), OTA/FOTA, diagnostics, telemetry, and device management.
* Define embedded security architecture for connected devices, including secure boot, signed firmware, secure update, key management, secure storage, and hardware root\-of\-trust options.
* Drive firmware platform reuse and maintainability through modular architecture, common drivers and services, BSP/HAL standards, boot/update frameworks, diagnostics, logging, and coding practices.
* Partner with Hardware, Product Management, Program Management, Certification, Manufacturing, Technical Support, Sales/FAE, and validation teams to deliver reliable, secure, production\-ready products.
* Mentor and, where applicable, manage firmware and validation engineers, raising technical standards through design reviews, code reviews, best practices, and cross\-functional technical leadership.
  

**Requirements \& Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 7\-10\+ years of embedded firmware development experience, ideally including multiple shipped connected\-device, wireless, telematics, tracking, router, gateway, industrial IoT, or embedded product programs.
* Proven experience defining firmware architecture across BSP, HAL, drivers, middleware, application services, boot/update flows, diagnostics, and device\-management interfaces.
* Experience with cellular modem integration, AT commands, GNSS, Wi\-Fi, BLE, sensors, and embedded communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS232, RS485, Ethernet, and USB.
* Experience with secure boot, bootloaders, signed firmware images, firmware update mechanisms, key management, secure storage, and secure debug/service access.
* Strong customer\-facing communication skills, with the ability to translate customer needs into firmware requirements and explain tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of device\-to\-cloud communication patterns, including MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, secure provisioning, device identity, telemetry, remote configuration, and firmware update workflows.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working with distributed or offshore engineering teams, including the ability to produce clear requirements, architecture documentation, technical handoff packages, and review feedback.
* Ability to lead by influence, mentor engineers, make architecture decisions, and remain hands\-on when required to resolve critical technical issues.
* Experience with embedded Linux, Linux BSPs, device trees, kernel drivers, Yocto/OpenWrt, routing/networking, gateway firmware, or Linux\-based edge devices. Linux experience is highly desirable.
  

**Location**


Remote or onsite in the USA

8beee15f.title: Group Technical Architect (AI Engagement Manager)_3095
8beee15f.description:
.
  
About the Job
  
The AI Factory is a central delivery unit at Allianz Technology that builds and deploys AI\-powered solutions across the Allianz Group. It runs four pillars, Personal Productivity, AI\-Native Ways of Working, Application Rebuild Modernization, and AI Use Case Delivery, on top of a shared AI platform ecosystem that provides the runtime, governance, observability, and reusable building blocks every solution runs on.
  
The AI Use Case Delivery team is the AI Factory's delivery engine for agentic and AI\-native solutions across Allianz Operating Entities. It accelerates high\-return AI initiatives through dedicated squads, a defined lifecycle from Idea to Handover, and a growing library of reusable AI building blocks that turn one OE's solution into the next OE's head start.
  
The AI Engagement Manager is the AI delivery interface between the AI Factory and the Operating Entities (OEs). The role turns OE and group pain points into deliverable, funded AI projects and steers several engagements in parallel. Where the Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical core of the squad, the Engagement Manager shapes the engagement and steers it to production: scoping the use case, shaping and executing demand, steering delivery, and owning the OE relationship beyond go\-live. It works on the Allianz Technology side while staying close to the OE, and involves the Head of IT or the respective global vertical from day one.
  
What You Do
  
  

* Form a half\-pizza squad with the Forward Deployed Engineers per OE engagement, together with the local IT or global vertical people who know the core systems.
* Shape and execute OE demand: make AI Factory capability visible early, match reusable building blocks (MVS) against the OE's actual pain points, and turn this into a funded engagement before the OE reaches outside.
* Steer multiple engagements in parallel across the full lifecycle, transferring patterns, framings, and lessons between them so the next engagement starts smarter than the last.
* Cut scope where it does not earn its place, validate assumptions fast, and correct course as the work unfolds.
* Own the build\-to\-run handover to the global service or local IT team, with the run team involved during delivery so the handover is real.
* Own the OE relationship after go\-live and prepare structured communications and decision papers for senior stakeholders up to CTO and Board level.


What You Bring
  
  

* A degree in business, management, technology, or a related field, with experience steering delivery or programmes in a larger organization; knowledge of Allianz Group and Allianz Technology is a plus.
* Senior enough for OE leadership and Head of IT conversations, technical enough to follow the build and cut scope honestly.
* Strong stakeholder, business\-framing, and roadmap\-shaping skills, with the ability to prepare clear decision materials for executive audiences.
* Experience translating business problems into delivered software, ideally in insurance or another regulated environment.
* An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable taking ownership and driving topics forward in a build\-up environment without waiting for perfect structure.
* Fluent in English
* Basic to solid knowledge of AI technologies, agentic principles, and their practical use.


What We Offer
  
  

* We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in\-person collaboration and remote working, including up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
* We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
* From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
* Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.


About Allianz Technology
  
With its headquarters in Munich, Germany, Allianz Technology is Allianz's global IT service provider and delivers IT solutions that drive the group's digitalization. With more than 11,000 employees in over 20 countries around the world, Allianz Technology is tasked with running, optimizing, transforming, and innovating the infrastructure, applications, and services together with Allianz companies to co\-create the best customer experience.
  
We service the entire spectrum of digitalization, from one of the industry's largest IT infrastructure projects that spans data centres, networks, and security, to application platforms ranging from workplace services to digital interaction. In short: We deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age. We are the backbone of Allianz. Find us at: www.linkedin.com/company/allianz\-technology.
  
Commitment to Integrity, Fairness Inclusion
  
Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace individuals of all gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ethnicities, ages, nationalities, religions, disabilities, and philosophies of life. Our greatest strength as a company lies in the unique skills, experiences, and backgrounds our employees contribute.
